:root{
  --navy:#061423;--navy2:#0b2034;--panel:#10283e;--panel2:#17364f;--line:#2c4b64;
  --ice:#e9f8fc;--text:#edf6fb;--muted:#9bb2c3;--accent:#f6d34a;--good:#22c55e;
  --danger:#ef4444;--orange:#f59e0b;--cyan:#39d8ff;--shadow:0 16px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.34);
  --timeline-h:264px;--left-w:332px;--right-w:338px;--toolbar-h:54px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}.hidden{display:none!important}body.left-hidden{--left-w:0px}body.left-hidden .left-drawer{display:none}body.right-hidden{--right-w:0px}body.right-hidden .right-drawer{display:none}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--navy);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{color:inherit}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(57,216,255,.55);outline-offset:2px}
body{display:grid;grid-template-rows:58px minmax(0,1fr) var(--toolbar-h) var(--timeline-h);transition:grid-template-rows .25s ease}
body.timeline-collapsed{--timeline-h:48px}
body.focus-mode{--left-w:0px;--right-w:0px}

body.focus-mode .workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr}

.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:220px}.brand img{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:9px;object-fit:contain;background:transparent;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0008}.brand-copy{line-height:1.05}.brand-copy strong{display:block;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.04em}.brand-copy span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.topbar-spacer{flex:1}.top-status{font-size:12px;color:#cfe2ef;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:38vw}

.play-card{border:1px solid #34556c;border-radius:10px;padding:9px;background:#102b40;margin:8px 0}.play-card h4{margin:0 0 3px;font-size:12px}.play-card p{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}.play-tag{display:inline-block;border-radius:99px;background:#255370;padding:2px 7px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px}.play-tag.half{background:#744f22}.playbook-logo{width:100%;height:130px;object-fit:contain;background:#061827;border:1px solid #2f5068;border-radius:10px;margin:6px 0 10px}

.rink-shell{min-height:0;flex:1;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}.rink-frame{position:relative;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 28px #0008)}.rink-frame.whole{aspect-ratio:5/3;width:min(100%,calc((100vh - 430px)*1.6667));min-width:520px}.rink-frame.half{aspect-ratio:6/7;height:100%;max-width:100%}.rink-svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none;user-select:none}.rink-frame.playing .selection-ring{display:none}.view-badge{position:absolute;left:16px;top:14px;background:#061827cc;border:1px solid #3c5b72;border-radius:99px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em}.offside-light{position:absolute;right:-19px;top:18px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e;border:2px solid #dfeef5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #061827,0 0 12px currentColor;z-index:4}.offside-light.orange{background:#b77908}.offside-light.red{background:#ef3340;animation:blinkLight .58s steps(1) infinite}@keyframes blinkLight{50%{opacity:.25}}
.live-hud{position:absolute;left:50%;top:18px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:none;z-index:8;background:#061827e8;border:1px solid #50bce8;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);text-align:center;pointer-events:none}.live-hud.active{display:block}.live-hud strong{display:block;color:#7ee7ff;font-size:12px}.live-hud span{font-size:10px;color:#c6dbe7}.goal-banner{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;place-items:center;pointer-events:none;z-index:7;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ef444455,transparent 55%)}.goal-banner.active{display:grid;animation:goalPulse .45s ease-in-out 5}.goal-banner div{background:#b71728;border:4px solid #fff;border-radius:18px;padding:13px 28px;font-size:34px;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 0 35px #ff304f}@keyframes goalPulse{50%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(1.025)}}
.right-drawer.closed{display:none}.right-content{overflow:auto;min-height:0;padding:12px}.inspector-empty{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;padding:8px}.identity-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;background:#0d2639;border:1px solid #315169;border-radius:11px;margin-bottom:10px}.identity-token{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000}.identity-token.goalie{border-radius:10px}.identity-token.puck{width:40px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#111;border-color:#69747c}.identity-card strong{font-size:14px}.identity-card small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}.status-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:99px;background:#173a52;border:1px solid #38627d;padding:4px 8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}.status-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e}.inspector-section{border-top:1px solid #2b4a62;padding-top:11px;margin-top:11px}.inspector-section h3{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:12px}.inspector-section p{margin:4px 0 8px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}.range-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:#bfd1dd}.range-label output{color:#fff;font-weight:800}.route-take-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;gap:6px}.route-take-row select{min-width:0}

.timeline-dock{min-height:0;background:#071724;border-top:1px solid #2c4d66;display:flex;flex-direction:column;z-index:35}.timeline-head{height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px svg text{font-family:inherit}.token-label{fill:#102033;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3px;stroke-linejoin:round}.selection-ring{fill:none;stroke:#ffffff;stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:9 6;animation:spinRing 2.2s linear infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}.selection-ring.puck-select{stroke:#f7d94c}@keyframes spinRing{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}.player-glow{animation:tokenBlink var(--blink,1s) ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes tokenBlink{to{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 var(--glow-size,10px) var(--glow-color,#39d8ff)) drop-shadow(0 0 calc(var(--glow-size,10px)*1.8) var(--glow-color,#39d8ff))}}.route-path{fill:none;stroke-width:5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;opacity:.72;marker-end:url(#routeArrow)}.route-path.past{opacity:.22}.preview-path{fill:none;stroke:#f59e0b;stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:9 7;stroke-linecap:round}.puck-disc{cursor:pointer;filter:drop-shadow(2px 4px 2px #0007)}.puck-spin{animation:puckSpin .34s linear infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}@keyframes puckSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* Version 5.2 responsive presentation layer */
:root{
  --usa-navy:#002f6c;--usa-blue:#0057b8;--usa-red:#c8102e;--usa-sky:#72c7e7;
  --left-w:360px;--right-w:388px;--toolbar-h:60px;--timeline-h:282px;
  --timeline-label-w:158px;
}
body{grid-template-rows:64px minmax(0,1fr) var(--toolbar-h) var(--timeline-h);font-size:15px}
body.timeline-hidden{--timeline-h:0px}
body.timeline-hidden .timeline-dock{display:none}
body.timeline-hidden .toast{bottom:calc(var(--toolbar-h) + 12px)}
.topbar{min-height:64px;padding:8px 14px;border-bottom-width:3px}
.brand-copy strong{font-size:17px}.brand-copy span{font-size:12px}.top-status{font-size:13px}
.btn,.icon-btn{min-height:42px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:750}.btn.small{min-height:36px;font-size:13px}.icon-btn{width:44px;font-size:21px}
.workspace{isolation:isolate}.stage{padding:7px 8px 5px}.rink-shell{width:100%;height:100%}.rink-frame.whole,.rink-frame.half{width:auto;height:auto;min-width:0;max-width:none;max-height:none}
.left-drawer,.right-drawer{display:flex!important;transition:transform .26s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.24,1),opacity .2s ease;will-change:transform,opacity}
body.left-hidden .left-drawer{display:flex!important;transform:translateX(-102%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
body.right-hidden .right-drawer{display:flex!important;transform:translateX(102%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.drawer-edge-handle{position:absolute;top:50%;z-index:45;width:28px;height:72px;margin-top:-36px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);font-size:25px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);transition:left .26s,right .26s,background .15s;display:grid;place-items:center}
.drawer-edge-handle:hover{background:var(--panel2)}
.drawer-edge-left{left:calc(var(--left-w) - 1px);border-radius:0 14px 14px 0}
.drawer-edge-right{right:calc(var(--right-w) - 1px);border-radius:14px 0 0 14px}
body.left-hidden .drawer-edge-left{left:0}
body.right-hidden .drawer-edge-right{right:0}
body.focus-mode .drawer-edge-handle{display:none}
.command-bar{min-height:60px;padding:7px 10px;gap:7px}.tool-btn{width:44px;height:44px;font-size:20px;border-radius:10px}.command-label{font-size:12px}
.timeline-dock{width:100vw;max-width:100vw}.timeline-head{width:100%;min-height:54px;height:auto;gap:7px;padding:7px 10px;overflow-x:auto}.timeline-body{overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden}.timeline-grid{width:100%;min-width:0}.ruler-row,.track-row{grid-template-columns:var(--timeline-label-w) minmax(0,1fr);width:100%}.ruler-lane,.track-lane{width:100%;min-width:0}.timeline-title{font-size:13px}.transport{width:38px;height:38px;font-size:15px}.time-code{font-size:12px;min-width:108px}
.possession-choice-list{display:grid;gap:6px;max-height:210px;overflow:auto;padding:3px}.possession-choice{display:grid;grid-template-columns:15px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;min-height:40px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);padding:7px 9px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.possession-choice:hover,.possession-choice:focus-visible,.possession-choice.active{border-color:var(--usa-red);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--usa-red) 22%,transparent)}.possession-choice .mini-dot{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid currentColor}.possession-choice small{opacity:.72}
.target-triangle{fill:none;stroke:#c8102e;stroke-width:4;stroke-linejoin:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #fff);animation:targetPulse 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}@keyframes targetPulse{to{transform:scale(1.09);opacity:.58}}
.selection-ring{fill:none;stroke:#050505;stroke-width:3.5;stroke-dasharray:10 6;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px #fff) drop-shadow(0 0 1px #fff);animation:vroomRing 3.15s cubic-bezier(.25,.05,.18,1) infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}.selection-ring.puck-select{stroke:#050505}
@keyframes vroomRing{0%{transform:rotate(0deg);stroke-dashoffset:0}15%{transform:rotate(38deg)}28%{transform:rotate(78deg)}48%{transform:rotate(300deg);stroke-dashoffset:-18}61%{transform:rotate(342deg)}78%{transform:rotate(610deg);stroke-dashoffset:-38}100%{transform:rotate(720deg);stroke-dashoffset:-52}}
.puck-glow-static{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 var(--glow-size,10px) var(--glow-color,#39d8ff)) drop-shadow(0 0 calc(var(--glow-size,10px)*1.8) var(--glow-color,#39d8ff))}
.canada-leaf path{fill:#d71920;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3;paint-order:stroke;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.28));pointer-events:none}
.theme-choice{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.appearance-card select{font-size:14px}

body.theme-light{
  --navy:#eef4f9;--navy2:#ffffff;--panel:#ffffff;--panel2:#eaf1f7;--line:#b7c9d9;
  --ice:#e9f8fc;--text:#0a2442;--muted:#536a7e;--accent:#c8102e;--good:#147a43;
  --danger:#b42318;--orange:#9a5a00;--cyan:#0057b8;--shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(20,50,75,.18);
  background:#eef4f9;color:var(--text)
}
body.theme-light .topbar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#edf3f8);border-color:var(--usa-red);color:#0a2442}
body.theme-light .brand-copy span,body.theme-light .top-status{color:#4a6277}
body.theme-light .workspace{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dfeaf3 0,#f8fbfd 52%,#dbe8f2 100%)}
body.theme-light .left-drawer,body.theme-light .right-drawer{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#edf3f8);border-color:#b5c8d8}
body.theme-light .drawer-head,body.theme-light .tabs,body.theme-light .section-card,body.theme-light .roster-card,body.theme-light .play-card,body.theme-light .team-card{border-color:#b9cbd9}
body.theme-light .section-card,body.theme-light .roster-card,body.theme-light .play-card,body.theme-light .team-card{background:#ffffff;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(22,55,82,.08)}
body.theme-light .tab-btn{background:#e4edf5;color:#294962}body.theme-light .tab-btn.active{background:var(--usa-blue);color:#fff}
body.theme-light .btn,body.theme-light .icon-btn,body.theme-light .swap-btn,body.theme-light .transport,body.theme-light .tool-btn{background:#ffffff;border-color:#9db4c7;color:#0b2f55;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(20,50,75,.08)}
body.theme-light .btn:hover,body.theme-light .icon-btn:hover,body.theme-light .tool-btn:hover{background:#e9f2f8}
body.theme-light .btn.primary,body.theme-light .transport.primary,body.theme-light .tool-btn.active{background:var(--usa-blue);border-color:#00458f;color:#fff}
body.theme-light .btn.good{background:#16814a;border-color:#0c6738;color:#fff}body.theme-light .btn.danger{background:#b42318;border-color:#8f1d14;color:#fff}
body.theme-light input,body.theme-light select,body.theme-light textarea,body.theme-light .field input[type=text],body.theme-light .field input[type=number],body.theme-light .field select,body.theme-light .field textarea,body.theme-light .team-card input,body.theme-light .roster-fields input,body.theme-light .roster-fields select{background:#fff;color:#0a2442;border-color:#9fb6c8}
body.theme-light .bench{background:#002f6c;border-color:#6e92b1}body.theme-light .bench-label{background:#002f6c;color:#fff}body.theme-light .bench-label span{color:#d5e6f4}
body.theme-light .command-bar{background:#ffffff;border-color:#a9bdcd;color:#0a2442}
body.theme-light .timeline-dock{background:#f4f8fb;border-color:#a9bdcd}.theme-light .timeline-head,.theme-light .ruler-label,.theme-light .track-label,.theme-light .ruler-lane{background:#e7eff6;color:#0b2f55;border-color:#b8cad8}.theme-light .track-lane{border-color:#c4d3df;background-color:#f9fbfd;background-image:linear-gradient(to right,#d5e1ea 1px,transparent 1px)}.theme-light .tick{color:#536d82;border-color:#b6c7d4}.theme-light .tick.major{border-color:#718da3}
body.theme-light .identity-card,body.theme-light .status-pill,body.theme-light .inspector-empty{background:#eef4f8;border-color:#b6c9d8;color:#0a2442}.theme-light .inspector-section{border-color:#c2d2de}
body.theme-light dialog{background:#fff;color:#0a2442;border-color:#9eb5c7}.theme-light .dialog-head,.theme-light .dialog-actions{border-color:#c1d0dc}.theme-light .color-tab{background:#e8f0f6;color:#123451;border-color:#9eb6c8}.theme-light .color-tab.active{background:var(--usa-blue);color:#fff}
body.theme-light .toast{background:#ffffffee;color:#0a2442;border-color:#8fa9bc}

body.theme-dark{background:#061423;color:#edf6fb}
body.theme-dark .btn.primary,body.theme-dark .transport.primary,body.theme-dark .tool-btn.active{background:#0b5f9a;border-color:#5ab9e5}

@media(max-width:1180px){
  :root{--timeline-label-w:132px}
  body:not(.left-hidden) .drawer-edge-left{left:min(360px,88vw)}
  body:not(.right-hidden) .drawer-edge-right{right:min(388px,88vw)}
  body.left-hidden .left-drawer,body.right-hidden .right-drawer{display:flex!important}
  .left-drawer,.right-drawer{display:flex!important}
  body.left-hidden .left-drawer{transform:translateX(-102%)}body.right-hidden .right-drawer{transform:translateX(102%)}
}
@media(max-width:720px){
  :root{--timeline-label-w:104px;--toolbar-h:54px;--timeline-h:238px}
  body{grid-template-rows:58px minmax(0,1fr) var(--toolbar-h) var(--timeline-h)}
  .drawer-edge-handle{width:25px;height:62px;margin-top:-31px}.timeline-head{padding:5px;gap:4px}.transport{width:35px;height:35px}.btn.small{font-size:11px}.command-bar{gap:4px}.tool-btn{width:39px;height:39px}
}


/* Version 5.2 classic board and branchable timeline */
:root{
  --timeline-h:344px;
  --timeline-label-w:164px;
}
body{grid-template-rows:64px minmax(0,1fr) var(--toolbar-h) var(--timeline-h)}
body.timeline-hidden{--timeline-h:0px}
.stage{padding:6px 8px 5px}
.bench-rack{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;min-height:84px;max-height:96px;margin-bottom:6px}
.bench{min-width:0;height:84px;padding:6px 7px;gap:7px;border-radius:12px;scrollbar-width:thin;align-items:stretch}
.bench-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-self:stretch;min-width:82px;padding:0 8px 0 3px;border-right:1px solid rgba(130,155,175,.35)}
.bench-label strong{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.035em}.bench-label span{font-size:9px;margin-top:3px}
.bench-token.bench-card{flex:0 0 clamp(158px,15vw,218px);width:auto;height:70px;min-height:70px;border:1px solid #b8cad8;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;color:#0a2442;text-shadow:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:6px 8px;box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(24,55,78,.1);text-align:left;overflow:hidden}
.bench-token.bench-card:hover{border-color:#0057b8;background:#f4f9fc;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.bench-piece{position:relative;flex:0 0 38px;width:38px;height:38px;border:4px solid var(--piece-trim);background:var(--piece-primary);color:var(--piece-ink);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:950;line-height:1;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.bench-card.goalie .bench-piece{width:34px;height:46px;flex-basis:34px;border-radius:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--piece-primary) 0 6px,var(--piece-trim) 6px 9px,var(--piece-primary) 9px 15px)}
.bench-card.staff .bench-piece{width:48px;height:34px;flex-basis:48px;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--piece-primary) 0 43%,var(--piece-trim) 43% 57%,var(--piece-primary) 57% 100%)}
.bench-card.staff .bench-piece:after{display:none}
.bench-card-copy{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;line-height:1.15}.bench-card-copy strong{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.bench-card-copy small{font-size:9px;color:#526a7e;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.bench-card-copy em{font-style:normal;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:850;color:#38566e;background:#e8f0f6;border-radius:99px;padding:2px 6px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%}
body.theme-dark .bench-token.bench-card{background:#10283e;border-color:#35536b;color:#edf6fb}.theme-dark .bench-card-copy small{color:#a9c0ce}.theme-dark .bench-card-copy em{background:#1a3b54;color:#d9e8f2}
body.theme-light .bench{background:#f2f7fb;border-color:#a9bdcd}.theme-light .bench-label{background:#f2f7fb;color:#0a2442}.theme-light .bench-label span{color:#536a7e}
.rink-frame{filter:drop-shadow(0 9px 17px rgba(21,45,64,.28))}.rink-frame.whole{min-width:0}
.ice-token{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.28))}.token-role-text{font-size:8px;font-weight:950;fill:#20384b;pointer-events:none}.token-number{font-size:14px;font-weight:950;paint-order:stroke;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.38);stroke-width:1.5px}.token-leadership{font-size:10px;font-weight:950;fill:#0b2133;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3px}.token-label{font-size:11px}.target-triangle{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.identity-token{position:relative;background:var(--piece-primary)!important;border-color:var(--piece-trim)!important;color:var(--piece-ink)!important;display:grid;place-items:center}.identity-token>span{font-size:11px;font-weight:950}.identity-token.goalie{width:40px;height:54px;border-radius:8px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--piece-primary) 0 8px,var(--piece-trim) 8px 11px,var(--piece-primary) 11px 18px)!important}.identity-token.staff{width:58px;height:42px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--piece-primary) 0 43%,var(--piece-trim) 43% 57%,var(--piece-primary) 57% 100%)!important}
.timeline-drawer-pill{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:44px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #9db4c7;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;color:#0b2f55;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:850;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(20,50,75,.08)}.timeline-drawer-pill:hover{background:#e9f2f8}.timeline-drawer-pill.active{background:#0057b8;border-color:#00458f;color:#fff}.timeline-pill-icon{font-size:16px}.timeline-pill-state{font-size:9px;opacity:.72;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}.timeline-pill-chevron{font-size:14px}
.theme-dark .timeline-drawer-pill{background:#142f44;color:#edf6fb;border-color:#35536b}.theme-dark .timeline-drawer-pill.active{background:#0b5f9a}
.timeline-dock{min-height:0}.timeline-head{flex:0 0 auto}.timeline-branchbar{flex:0 0 auto;min-height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #29485f;background:#0d293e;overflow-x:auto}.variation-cluster,.reuse-cluster{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap}.reuse-cluster{margin-left:auto}.branch-label{font-size:9px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)}.timeline-branchbar select{min-width:126px;max-width:190px;height:34px;border:1px solid #35536b;border-radius:8px;background:#10283e;color:#fff;padding:5px 8px}.reuse-output{display:inline-block;min-width:210px;max-width:320px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:10px;color:#b9ccda;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.timeline-branchbar .btn.small{min-height:34px;padding:5px 9px}
.theme-light .timeline-branchbar{background:#f0f5f9;border-color:#b8cad8}.theme-light .timeline-branchbar select{background:#fff;color:#0a2442;border-color:#9fb6c8}.theme-light .reuse-output{color:#536a7e}
.reuse-range{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(0,87,184,.16);border-left:2px solid #0057b8;border-right:2px solid #0057b8;z-index:4;pointer-events:none}.reuse-boundary{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;z-index:5;pointer-events:none}.reuse-in{background:#16814a}.reuse-out{background:#c8102e}.reuse-boundary:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:19px;left:-4px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}.reuse-in{color:#16814a}.reuse-out{color:#c8102e}
.puck-event.place{background:#5b3f8f}.movement-clip{border-width:1px}.movement-clip.selected{outline-offset:1px}
.replace-help{font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.45!important;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(0,87,184,.08);border-left:3px solid #0057b8}.replace-record-row{margin:8px 0 2px}.inspector-section>#recordMoveHereBtn{margin-top:7px;width:100%}.inspector-section>#recordMoveBtn{width:100%}#replacePuckFromPlayheadBtn{width:100%;margin-top:7px}
.timeline-body{flex:1 1 auto}.timeline-grid{min-height:100%}
body.timeline-hidden .timeline-dock{display:none}
body.timeline-hidden .rink-frame{filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 20px rgba(21,45,64,.28))}
@media(max-width:1180px){
  :root{--timeline-h:326px;--timeline-label-w:132px}
  .bench-rack{min-height:78px;max-height:88px}.bench{height:78px}.bench-token.bench-card{height:64px;min-height:64px;flex-basis:168px}.bench-piece{width:34px;height:34px;flex-basis:34px}.bench-card.goalie .bench-piece{height:42px}.bench-card.staff .bench-piece{width:44px;flex-basis:44px}
  .reuse-output{min-width:170px}.timeline-branchbar{gap:5px}.timeline-branchbar .btn.small{font-size:11px}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  :root{--timeline-h:310px;--timeline-label-w:112px}
  .bench-rack{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:70px;max-height:78px}.bench{height:70px;padding:4px}.bench-label{min-width:60px;padding:0 5px}.bench-token.bench-card{height:60px;min-height:60px;flex-basis:150px;padding:4px 6px}.bench-card-copy strong{font-size:10px}.bench-card-copy em{display:none}
  .timeline-branchbar{min-height:44px;padding:4px 6px}.branch-label,.reuse-output{display:none}.timeline-branchbar select{min-width:108px}.reuse-cluster{margin-left:0}.timeline-drawer-pill{height:40px;padding:0 9px}.timeline-pill-state{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .bench-rack{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:108px;max-height:116px}.bench{height:52px}.bench-token.bench-card{height:44px;min-height:44px;flex-basis:138px}.bench-piece{width:30px;height:30px;flex-basis:30px;border-width:3px}.bench-card.goalie .bench-piece{height:35px}.bench-card.staff .bench-piece{height:28px;width:40px;flex-basis:40px}.bench-label{min-width:56px}.timeline-branchbar{overflow-x:auto}.timeline-drawer-pill .timeline-pill-icon{display:none}
}

/* Version 5.3 — frame-accurate player action revision (legacy compatibility) */
.action-change-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #0d6d91;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eafaff,#d6f3fb);color:#07384a;font:800 11px/1 inherit;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(7,56,74,.13);cursor:pointer}
.action-change-pill:hover{filter:brightness(.98);transform:translateY(-1px)}.action-change-pill:active{transform:none}.action-change-pill[hidden]{display:none!important}.action-change-pill .action-context-time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;background:#07384a;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 7px}.action-change-pill .action-context-name{max-width:132px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.action-now-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:9px 10px;margin:0 0 9px;border:1px solid rgba(13,109,145,.25);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(13,109,145,.07)}.action-now-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:#07384a;color:#fff;font-size:17px;font-weight:900}.action-now-card strong{display:block;font-size:12px}.action-now-card small{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}
.action-edit-dialog{width:min(620px,calc(100vw - 24px));max-height:min(820px,calc(100vh - 24px));padding:0;border:0;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 28px 90px rgba(5,19,31,.42);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text)}.action-edit-dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(4,15,25,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}.action-edit-dialog[open]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.action-edit-head,.action-edit-actions{flex:0 0 auto}.action-edit-body{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;max-height:none!important}.action-edit-head{padding:18px 20px 14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#07384a,#0d6d91);color:#fff}.action-edit-head h2{margin:0;font-size:20px}.action-edit-head p{margin:6px 0 0;opacity:.9;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}.action-edit-body{padding:16px 20px;overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 190px)}.action-edit-section{margin:0 0 16px}.action-edit-section h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}.action-type-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.action-type-btn{min-width:0;padding:10px 5px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--text);font:800 10px/1.15 inherit;cursor:pointer}.action-type-btn span{display:block;font-size:19px;margin-bottom:5px}.action-type-btn.active{border-color:#0d6d91;background:#daf5ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(13,109,145,.2);color:#07384a}.theme-dark .action-type-btn.active{background:#0f4a60;color:#fff}.action-duration-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center}.action-duration-row output{min-width:66px;text-align:right;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.duration-quick-row{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}.duration-quick-row button{min-width:54px}.action-scope-list{display:grid;gap:8px}.action-scope-option{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:9px;align-items:start;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:var(--panel-2);cursor:pointer}.action-scope-option:has(input:checked){border-color:#0d6d91;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(13,109,145,.14)}.action-scope-option system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;pointer-events:none}.token-action-cue.action-backward rect{fill:#7c2d12}.token-action-cue.action-lateral rect{fill:#6b21a8}.token-action-cue.action-glide rect{fill:#075985}.token-action-cue.action-hold rect{fill:#334155}
.action-record-hud{position:absolute;z-index:8;left:50%;top:14px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;max-width:calc(100% - 28px);padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(4,27,39,.92);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);font-size:11px;pointer-events:none}.action-record-hud[hidden]{display:none}.action-record-hud strong{white-space:nowrap}.action-record-hud span{opacity:.88;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.action-record-hud button{pointer-events:auto;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;background:#fff;color:#07384a;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}
