.route-path.action-backward{stroke-dasharray:12 7}.route-path.action-lateral{stroke-dasharray:16 5 3 5}.route-path.action-glide{stroke-dasharray:3 9;opacity:.55}.route-hold-marker{fill:rgba(255,255,255,.4);stroke-width:4;opacity:.8}.action-anchor-ring{fill:none;stroke:#0d6d91;stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:7 5;animation:spinRing 2.2s linear infinite}.action-anchor-line{stroke:#0d6d91;stroke-width:2;stroke-dasharray:4 4}.action-anchor-label{font:900 11px/1 inherit;fill:#07384a;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:4px;stroke-linejoin:round}
.clip-action-editor{margin-bottom:10px}.clip-action-editor select{width:100%}.action-revision-note{font-size:10px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted)}
.token-action-badge{pointer-events:none}.token-action-badge rect{fill:#07384a;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2.5;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}.token-action-badge text{fill:#fff;font:1000 12px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;paint-order:stroke;stroke:#07384a;stroke-width:1px}.token-action-badge.action-hold rect{fill:#7c2d12}.token-action-badge.action-backward rect{fill:#6d28d9}.token-action-badge.action-lateral rect{fill:#0369a1}.token-action-badge.action-glide rect{fill:#475569}
body.action-recording .command-bar{opacity:.72}body.action-recording .rink-svg{cursor:crosshair}
@media(max-width:1100px){.action-change-pill .action-context-name{display:none}.action-type-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:720px){.action-change-pill{padding:0 8px}.action-change-pill .action-context-label{display:none}.action-change-pill .action-context-time{padding:3px 6px}.action-edit-body{padding:14px}.action-edit-head{padding:15px}.action-edit-actions{padding:10px 14px}.action-type-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.action-record-hud{top:8px;border-radius:12px}.action-record-hud span{display:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.action-anchor-ring{animation:none}}


/* Version 5.4: category benches and direct move-from-playhead workflow (legacy compatibility). */
.bench-rack.category-benches{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.55fr) minmax(0,.78fr) minmax(0,.88fr);gap:8px;min-height:86px;max-height:100px}
.bench-category{min-width:0}
.bench-category .bench-label{min-width:78px}
.bench-card-copy .team-line{font-weight:850;color:#0d5f95}
.theme-dark .bench-card-copy .team-line{color:#8dd7ff}
.action-change-pill .action-context-label{font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.03em}
@media(max-width:900px){.bench-rack.category-benches{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:150px;max-height:160px}.bench-category{height:72px}.bench-category:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}.bench-category .bench-token.bench-card{height:60px;min-height:60px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.bench-rack.category-benches{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:162px;max-height:172px}.bench-category{height:52px}.bench-category .bench-token.bench-card{height:44px;min-height:44px}}


/* Version 5.6 baseline — two ordered team benches and route-only player editing. */
.top-status{display:none!important}
.topbar{gap:10px}.topbar-spacer{flex:1 1 auto}
.bench-drawer{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:0;margin:0 0 6px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(104,137,163,.58);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(5,26,43,.92);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(3,18,31,.14)}
.bench-drawer-toggle{width:100%;height:29px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(118,151,177,.42);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#123653,#09253b);color:#eff8ff;cursor:pointer;font:900 10px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.055em;text-align:left}
.bench-drawer-toggle:hover{filter:brightness(1.07)}.bench-drawer-toggle:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #72c7e7;outline-offset:-3px}
.bench-drawer-title{white-space:nowrap}.bench-drawer-summary{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#b9d9ec;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0}.bench-drawer-state{margin-left:auto;color:#d9eaf4;letter-spacing:0}.bench-drawer-chevron{display:grid;place-items:center;width:20px;font-size:17px;line-height:1;transition:transform .2s ease}
.bench-rack.team-benches{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;min-height:84px;max-height:96px;margin:0;padding:6px;opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);transition:max-height .22s ease,min-height .22s ease,padding .22s ease,opacity .16s ease,transform .22s ease}
.bench-rack.team-benches .bench{height:72px;min-height:72px;padding:5px 7px;align-items:stretch}
.bench-rack.team-benches .bench-label{min-width:82px}
body.benches-hidden .bench-drawer{margin-bottom:4px}
body.benches-hidden .bench-drawer-toggle{border-bottom-color:transparent}
body.benches-hidden .bench-rack.team-benches{min-height:0!important;max-height:0!important;height:0!important;padding-top:0!important;padding-bottom:0!important;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px);pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
body.benches-hidden .bench-drawer-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)}
body.theme-light .bench-drawer{background:#f8fbfd;border-color:#a9bdcd;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(26,59,83,.1)}
body.theme-light .bench-drawer-toggle{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef5fa,#dce8f1);border-color:#b5c8d8;color:#0a3158}
body.theme-light .bench-drawer-summary{color:#536f85}body.theme-light .bench-drawer-state{color:#234b6b}
.action-edit-dialog,.clip-action-editor,.action-now-card,.token-action-badge{display:none!important}
.movement-clip .clip-action-glyph{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .bench-rack.team-benches{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);min-height:74px;max-height:82px;padding:4px}
  .bench-rack.team-benches .bench{height:66px;min-height:66px;padding:4px}.bench-rack.team-benches .bench-label{min-width:62px;padding-left:2px;padding-right:5px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .topbar{gap:5px;padding-left:6px;padding-right:6px}.brand{gap:6px}.brand img{width:36px;height:36px}.brand-copy strong{font-size:12px}.brand-copy span{display:none}
  .topbar #newBoardBtn,.topbar #savePlayTopBtn{display:inline-flex!important;min-height:34px;padding:5px 7px;font-size:11px}.topbar #focusBtn{width:36px;min-height:36px}
  .bench-rack.team-benches{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:124px;max-height:136px}.bench-rack.team-benches .bench{height:58px;min-height:58px}.bench-rack.team-benches .bench-token.bench-card{height:48px;min-height:48px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bench-rack.team-benches,.bench-drawer-chevron{transition:none}}



/* Version 5.6 — compact puck controls, disclosure sections, and clearer puck-route notation. */
.identity-token.puck{
  width:42px;height:20px;border-radius:4px;border:2px solid #4d565c;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1b2024 0 34%,#080a0c 35% 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.22)
}
.identity-token.puck::after{content:"";width:68%;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:#59636a;opacity:.75}
.identity-card-with-action>div:nth-child(2){min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto}
.identity-card-with-action>div:nth-child(2) small{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.return-bench-top{margin-left:auto;flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap;min-height:32px!important;padding:5px 8px!important;font-size:10px!important}
.inspector-section.inspector-collapsible{padding-top:5px}
.inspector-disclosure{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 4px;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;font:900 12px/1.2 inherit}
.inspector-disclosure:hover{background:rgba(80,160,205,.11)}
.inspector-disclosure:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(57,216,255,.48);outline-offset:1px}
.disclosure-arrow{display:grid;place-items:center;width:19px;height:19px;flex:0 0 19px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:5px;font:1000 11px/1 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;opacity:.72}
.inspector-collapse-content{padding:5px 2px 1px 27px}
.inspector-collapse-content[hidden]{display:none!important}
#addPossessionBtn.targeting{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,.24),0 2px 0 #0003}
.puck-pass-route{stroke:#111315!important;stroke-dasharray:11 8!important;stroke-width:5.2!important;opacity:.88!important;marker-end:url(#passArrow)!important}
.puck-shot-route{fill:none;stroke-width:5.4!important;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;opacity:.94!important;pointer-events:none}
.puck-shot-route.shot-black{stroke:#111315!important;stroke-dasharray:12 20!important;stroke-dashoffset:0;marker-end:url(#shotArrow)!important;animation:v56ShotBlack .76s linear infinite}
.puck-shot-route.shot-red{stroke:#e32636!important;stroke-dasharray:12 20!important;stroke-dashoffset:-16;marker-end:none!important;animation:v56ShotRed .76s linear infinite}
@keyframes v56ShotBlack{from{stroke-dashoffset:0}to{stroke-dashoffset:-32}}
@keyframes v56ShotRed{from{stroke-dashoffset:-16}to{stroke-dashoffset:-48}}
body.theme-light .inspector-disclosure{color:#0a2442}
body.theme-light .disclosure-arrow{background:#f7fbfe;border-color:#7896aa}
@media(max-width:430px){.return-bench-top{font-size:9px!important;padding:5px 6px!important}.identity-card-with-action{gap:7px}.inspector-collapse-content{padding-left:22px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.puck-shot-route.shot-black,.puck-shot-route.shot-red{animation:none!important}}


/* Version 5.7 — always-available transport, circle-on-circle marker preview,
   timeline-to-player focus, animated target acquisition, and paired puck routes. */
.legacy-step-control{display:none!important}
.toolbar-playback{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;margin-left:auto;padding:2px 5px;border:1px solid rgba(82,114,138,.55);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(6,24,39,.58);white-space:nowrap}
.toolbar-playback .transport{width:31px;min-width:31px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1;padding:0}
.toolbar-playback .transport.primary{width:36px;min-width:36px;font-size:16px}
.toolbar-playback .toolbar-speed{width:61px;height:34px;flex:0 0 61px;border:1px solid #35536b;border-radius:8px;background:#10283e;color:#fff;padding:4px 3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}
.toolbar-playback .time-code{min-width:88px;padding:0 3px;font-size:10px;text-align:center;color:#dcebf4;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
body.theme-light .toolbar-playback{background:#eaf1f6;border-color:#a7bbc9}
body.theme-light .toolbar-playback .toolbar-speed{background:#fff;color:#0a2442;border-color:#9db4c7}
body.theme-light .toolbar-playback .time-code{color:#244b68}

#markerSwatch.marker-swatch{--marker-color:#111827;--marker-width-preview:10px;position:relative;width:40px;height:40px;min-width:40px;padding:0!important;border-radius:50%!important;border:3px solid #f7fbfe!important;background:var(--marker-color);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.48),0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.24)!important;overflow:visible}
#markerSwatch .marker-width-dot{display:block;width:var(--marker-width-preview);height:var(--marker-width-preview);border-radius:50%;background:var(--marker-color);border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.72),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.42);pointer-events:none;transition:width .14s ease,height .14s ease,background .14s ease}
body.theme-light #markerSwatch.marker-swatch{border-color:#fff!important}

.timeline-player-focus-ring{fill:none;stroke:#ffd400;stroke-width:6;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px #111) drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(255,212,0,.92));pointer-events:none;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:v57TimelinePlayerFocus .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes v57TimelinePlayerFocus{from{opacity:.72;transform:scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.06)}}

.target-triangle{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;pointer-events:none}
.target-triangle-core{stroke:#ff2434!important;stroke-width:4.5!important;stroke-dasharray:15 8;fill:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px #fff) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,36,52,.8));animation:v57TargetAcquire 1.12s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.26,1) infinite!important}
.target-triangle-scan{stroke:#ffd400!important;stroke-width:2.2!important;stroke-dasharray:4 13;fill:none;opacity:.9;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px #111);animation:v57TargetScan 1.12s linear infinite!important}
.target-lock-dot{fill:#ffd400;stroke:#111;stroke-width:2;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ffd400);pointer-events:none;animation:v57TargetDot 1.12s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes v57TargetAcquire{0%{opacity:.18;transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.46);stroke-dashoffset:0}42%{opacity:1;transform:rotate(0deg) scale(1.04);stroke-dashoffset:-16}58%{transform:scale(.94);stroke:#ffd400}72%{transform:scale(1.03);stroke:#ff2434}100%{opacity:.96;transform:scale(1);stroke-dashoffset:-46}}
@keyframes v57TargetScan{0%{opacity:.15;transform:rotate(0deg) scale(1.2);stroke-dashoffset:0}45%{opacity:1;transform:rotate(150deg) scale(1.02)}100%{opacity:.5;transform:rotate(360deg) scale(.98);stroke-dashoffset:-34}}
@keyframes v57TargetDot{0%,38%{opacity:0;transform:scale(2.2)}55%,78%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}100%{opacity:.25;transform:scale(.72)}}

.timeline-head .timeline-duration{margin-left:auto}.timeline-head .timeline-collapse{margin-left:0}
.variation-cluster,.puck-route-cluster,.reuse-cluster{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap}
.puck-route-cluster{padding-left:8px;border-left:1px solid rgba(115,145,167,.42)}
.timeline-branchbar .puck-route-cluster select{min-width:126px;max-width:190px;height:34px;border:1px solid #35536b;border-radius:8px;background:#10283e;color:#fff;padding:5px 8px}
body.theme-light .timeline-branchbar .puck-route-cluster select{background:#fff;color:#0a2442;border-color:#9fb6c8}

@media(max-width:1180px){
  .toolbar-playback{padding-left:3px;padding-right:3px}.toolbar-playback .time-code{display:none}#fullscreenBottomBtn{display:none!important}
  .toolbar-playback .transport{width:29px;min-width:29px}.toolbar-playback .transport.primary{width:34px;min-width:34px}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .command-bar{gap:4px;padding-left:6px;padding-right:6px}.toolbar-playback{gap:2px}.toolbar-playback .transport{width:28px;min-width:28px;height:32px;font-size:11px}.toolbar-playback .transport.primary{width:33px;min-width:33px}.toolbar-playback .toolbar-speed{width:56px;flex-basis:56px;height:32px;font-size:9px}
  .puck-route-cluster{padding-left:5px}.timeline-branchbar .puck-route-cluster select{min-width:108px}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .toolbar-playback{margin-left:0}.command-spacer{min-width:0}.route-toggle span{display:none}.puck-route-cluster{border-left:0;padding-left:0}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .timeline-player-focus-ring,.target-triangle-core,.target-triangle-scan,.target-lock-dot{animation:none!important}.target-triangle-core{transform:scale(1)!important;opacity:1!important}.target-triangle-scan{opacity:.7!important;transform:none!important}.target-lock-dot{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
}


/* Version 5.8 — rotated full/half geometry, half-ice off-side logic,
   unobstructed route tracing, and a single timeline drawer control. */
#actionRecordHud,.action-record-hud{display:none!important}
.action-anchor-v53{display:none!important}
.timeline-head .action-change-pill{flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:min(430px,46vw);margin-right:4px}
.timeline-head .action-change-pill .action-context-name{max-width:210px}
.timeline-head .timeline-duration{margin-left:auto}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .timeline-head .action-change-pill{max-width:52vw;padding:0 9px;gap:5px}
  .timeline-head .action-change-pill .action-context-name{max-width:120px}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .timeline-head .action-change-pill .action-context-label{display:none}
  .timeline-head .action-change-pill .action-context-name{max-width:84px}
}


/* Version 6.0: rink-view controls live on the rink, not in Settings. */
.rink-frame.half{aspect-ratio:20/17}
.view-badge{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;z-index:7;min-height:27px;color:#edf6fb;line-height:1;border:1px solid #3c5b72;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:top .16s ease,background .16s ease,transform .12s ease}
.view-badge:hover{background:#0d2b41ee;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.view-badge:focus-visible,.half-end-pill:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffd400;outline-offset:2px}
.rink-frame.half .view-badge{top:51px}
.half-end-pill{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;position:absolute;left:16px;top:13px;z-index:8;width:122px;height:31px;margin:0;padding:3px;border:1px solid #3c5b72;border-radius:999px;background:#061827e6;color:#d8e8f3;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.28);cursor:pointer;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;font-family:inherit;font-size:8px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1;overflow:hidden}
.half-end-pill[hidden]{display:none!important}
.half-end-pill-thumb{position:absolute;left:3px;top:3px;width:calc(50% - 3px);height:23px;border-radius:999px;background:#f8fbfd;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);pointer-events:none}
.half-end-pill[data-side="right"] .half-end-pill-thumb{transform:translateX(100%)}
.half-end-pill-label{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;align-self:stretch;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.half-end-pill[data-side="left"] .half-end-pill-left,.half-end-pill[data-side="right"] .half-end-pill-right{color:#061423}
.half-end-pill[data-side="left"] .half-end-pill-right,.half-end-pill[data-side="right"] .half-end-pill-left{color:#d8e8f3}
.token-role-text{dominant-baseline:central;alignment-baseline:central}
@media(max-width:560px){.half-end-pill{left:10px;top:9px;width:112px;height:29px}.half-end-pill-thumb{height:21px}.rink-frame.half .view-badge{left:10px;top:44px}.rink-frame.whole .view-badge{left:10px;top:10px}}

/* Version 6.0 — rink-first, inspectorless contextual controls. */
:root{
  --right-w:0px!important;
  --v60-glass:rgba(5,20,35,.94);
  --v60-glass-soft:rgba(10,34,55,.92);
  --v60-border:rgba(255,255,255,.24);
  --v60-white:#f8fbff;
  --v60-blue:#0877c9;
  --v60-blue-hi:#24a3ef;
  --v60-red:#d7263d;
}
.workspace{grid-template-columns:var(--left-w) minmax(0,1fr)!important}
.right-drawer,.drawer-edge-right,#rightDrawerHandle,.v60-compat-inspector{display:none!important;visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#changeActionAtPlayheadBtn,#actionRecordHud,.action-record-hud{display:none!important}
.rink-frame{isolation:isolate}
.v60-context-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:30;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;border-radius:inherit}
.v60-context-layer [hidden],#v60TimelineContext[hidden]{display:none!important}
.v60-context-menu,.v60-shot-panel,.v60-mode-cancel{pointer-events:auto}
.v60-context-menu{
  position:absolute;z-index:4;padding:5px;border:1px solid var(--v60-border);border-radius:17px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,40,60,.97),var(--v60-glass));
  color:var(--v60-white);box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,15,28,.36),0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(1.18);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(1.18);
  transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:v60PopoverIn .14s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1) both;white-space:nowrap
}
.v60-context-menu.below{transform-origin:50% 0}
.v60-context-menu:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-7px;width:13px;height:13px;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);background:var(--v60-glass);border-right:1px solid var(--v60-border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--v60-border)}
.v60-context-menu.below:after{top:-7px;bottom:auto;border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--v60-border);border-top:1px solid var(--v60-border)}
.v60-context-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.v60-float-button{
  min-height:42px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 15px;background:transparent;color:#edf7ff;
  font-size:13px;font-weight:820;letter-spacing:.01em;cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s ease,transform .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease
}
.v60-float-button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.v60-float-button:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.v60-float-button.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--v60-blue-hi),var(--v60-blue));color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25),0 3px 9px rgba(0,92,160,.35)}
.v60-float-button.primary:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#36b0f4,#0b83d8)}
.v60-float-button.secondary{color:#f4f8fb}
.v60-float-button.shot{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ef4055,#b81730);box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.24),0 3px 9px rgba(155,8,33,.32)}
.v60-float-button.shot:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fb5368,#cc1d37)}
@keyframes v60PopoverIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px) scale(.94)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}

.v60-mode-cancel{
  position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:6;min-height:38px;padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(4,19,32,.9);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.24);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);cursor:pointer
}
.v60-mode-cancel:hover{background:#132e43}
.v60-shot-panel{
  position:absolute;z-index:5;width:min(310px,calc(100% - 16px));padding:11px 12px 10px;border:1px solid var(--v60-border);border-radius:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,40,60,.98),rgba(4,19,33,.96));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 15px 34px rgba(0,12,24,.4);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.15);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.15);animation:v60PopoverIn .14s ease-out both
}
.v60-shot-panel:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-7px;width:13px;height:13px;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);background:rgba(4,19,33,.96);border-right:1px solid var(--v60-border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--v60-border)}
.v60-shot-panel.below:after{top:-7px;bottom:auto;background:rgba(17,40,60,.98);border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--v60-border);border-top:1px solid var(--v60-border)}
.v60-shot-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#cfe4f2}
.v60-shot-heading output{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:0;color:#fff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v60-shot-panel input[type=range]{width:100%;height:26px;margin:0;accent-color:#ef3048;cursor:pointer}
.v60-shot-hint{margin:1px 0 8px;color:#abc4d4;font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}
.v60-shot-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:7px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.v60-shot-actions button{min-height:36px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:6px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.v60-shot-actions .commit{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ef4055,#b81730);border-color:#ff6a7c}

.v60-pass-preview{fill:none;stroke:#111820;stroke-width:5.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-dasharray:13 9;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px #fff) drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35));animation:v60PassFlow .7s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes v60PassFlow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-44}}
.v60-open-target{pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}
.v60-open-target circle{fill:rgba(255,255,255,.72);stroke:#101820;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-dasharray:5 4;animation:v60TargetSpin 1s linear infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.v60-open-target path{fill:none;stroke:#101820;stroke-width:2.5;stroke-linecap:round}
@keyframes v60TargetSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.v60-shot-preview{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.85))}
.v60-shot-preview-black{stroke:#111820;stroke-width:8;stroke-dasharray:15 13;animation:v60ShotBlack var(--v60-shot-dash-speed,.55s) linear infinite}
.v60-shot-preview-red{stroke:#ef263f;stroke-width:5;stroke-dasharray:15 13;stroke-dashoffset:14;animation:v60ShotRed var(--v60-shot-dash-speed,.55s) linear infinite}
@keyframes v60ShotBlack{to{stroke-dashoffset:-56}}
@keyframes v60ShotRed{to{stroke-dashoffset:-42}}
.v60-shot-target{pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #fff)}
.v60-shot-target circle:first-child{fill:rgba(239,38,63,.08);stroke:#ef263f;stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:6 4;animation:v60TargetSpin .75s linear infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.v60-shot-target circle:last-child{fill:#111820;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1.5}

#v60TimelineContext{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:max-content;flex:1}
.v60-timeline-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid #6ca9c8;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 11px;background:rgba(31,112,153,.15);white-space:nowrap}
.v60-timeline-chip strong{font-size:11px}.v60-timeline-chip span{font-size:10px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted)}
.v60-timeline-number{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;min-height:34px;padding:3px 7px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel2) 82%,transparent);white-space:nowrap}
.v60-timeline-number>span{font-size:9px;font-weight:850;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted)}
.v60-timeline-number input{width:58px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;padding:2px;outline:0}
.v60-timeline-number em{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);font-style:normal}
.timeline-head>.timeline-duration{margin-left:auto}

body.theme-light .v60-timeline-number{background:#fff;border-color:#9fb8ca}
body.theme-light .v60-timeline-chip{background:#e6f3fb;border-color:#6da5c5}
body.theme-light .v60-timeline-chip span,body.theme-light .v60-timeline-number>span,body.theme-light .v60-timeline-number em{color:#4f687b}
body.theme-light .v60-timeline-number input{color:#0a2442}

@media(max-width:900px){
  .v60-float-button{min-height:40px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:12px}
  .v60-shot-panel{width:min(286px,calc(100% - 12px));padding:9px 10px}
  #v60TimelineContext{gap:4px}.v60-timeline-chip{padding:3px 8px}.v60-timeline-number{padding:2px 5px}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .v60-context-menu{padding:4px;border-radius:15px}.v60-float-button{padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px}
  .v60-mode-cancel{top:7px;right:7px;min-height:34px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .v60-context-menu,.v60-shot-panel{animation:none!important}
  .v60-pass-preview,.v60-shot-preview,.v60-open-target circle,.v60-shot-target circle{animation:none!important}
}

/* Below desktop width the existing drawers become overlays, so the stage owns the only grid track. */
@media(max-width:1180px){
  .workspace{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}
}


/* Version 6.1 — contextual timing, refined shots, pinch zoom, timeline glow,
   Pencil-friendly scrubbing, and intelligent telestration. */

/* Rink floating actions: controls only, no dark container. */
.v60-context-menu{
  padding:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;
  overflow:visible!important
}
.v60-context-menu:after{display:none!important}
.v60-context-actions{gap:7px!important}
.v60-float-button{
  min-height:42px!important;padding:8px 16px!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82)!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;background:rgba(250,253,255,.96)!important;color:#09233a!important;
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,22,39,.25),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2)!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px)!important
}
.v60-float-button:hover{background:#fff!important;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.v60-float-button.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2ca8ed,#0877c9)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#7ad4ff!important}
.v60-float-button.shot{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f04d5d,#c91f35)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#ff8a98!important}
.v60-float-button.bench{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ef4758,#bd172d)!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#ff8a98!important}
body.theme-light .v60-float-button:not(.primary):not(.shot):not(.bench){background:rgba(255,255,255,.97)!important}

/* Compact, two-stage shot controls. */
.v60-shot-panel{
  width:min(300px,calc(100% - 20px))!important;padding:10px 11px 9px!important;border-radius:16px!important;
  background:rgba(8,27,42,.94)!important;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,15,28,.32)!important
}
.v60-shot-panel:after{display:none!important}
.v61-shot-summary{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;color:#aec7d7;font-size:10px;margin:2px 0 7px}
.v61-shot-summary strong{color:#fff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v61-shot-scale{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#8faabd;font-size:9px;margin-top:-4px;margin-bottom:6px}
.v60-shot-actions{justify-content:space-between!important}
.v60-shot-actions .v61-shot-secondary{margin-right:auto}
.v60-shot-actions button{border-radius:999px!important;min-height:34px!important;padding:5px 11px!important}
.v60-shot-panel input[type=range]{accent-color:#e93649!important;touch-action:none}

/* Lighter, less intrusive shot aim and route preview. */
.v61-shot-guide,.v61-shot-path-base,.v61-shot-path-flow{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none}
.v61-shot-guide{stroke:#c92b3d;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-dasharray:8 8;opacity:.78;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 1px #fff)}
.v61-shot-path-base{stroke:#111b24;stroke-width:3.1;opacity:.7}
.v61-shot-path-flow{stroke:#e12d40;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-dasharray:8 12;opacity:.92;animation:v61ShotFlow var(--v61-shot-flow,.75s) linear infinite}
.v61-shot-end{fill:#fff;stroke:#d92b3e;stroke-width:2.2;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.v61-shot-aim-dot{fill:#fff;stroke:#c92b3d;stroke-width:2;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3))}
@keyframes v61ShotFlow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-40}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v61-shot-path-flow{animation:none!important}}

/* Puck should skim rather than spin like a ball. */
.puck-spin{animation:v61PuckSkim .72s ease-in-out infinite alternate!important;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
@keyframes v61PuckSkim{from{transform:translateY(0) scaleX(1)}to{transform:translateY(-.7px) scaleX(.97)}}

/* Timeline contextual editor. */
#v60TimelineContext{overflow:visible;min-width:0!important;flex:1 1 auto!important}
.v61-timeline-editor{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-width:max-content;white-space:nowrap}
.v61-duration-control{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(130px,220px) auto;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:36px;padding:3px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel2) 84%,transparent)}
.v61-duration-control>span{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.055em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.v61-duration-control input[type=range]{width:clamp(130px,16vw,220px);height:26px;margin:0;accent-color:#148ac5;touch-action:none}
.v61-duration-control output{min-width:48px;text-align:right;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--text)}
.v61-speed-readout{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;min-height:34px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(34,154,202,.1);border:1px solid rgba(77,174,214,.35);font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}
.v61-speed-readout strong{color:var(--text);font-size:10px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v61-glow-editor{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:34px;padding:3px 7px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--panel2) 82%,transparent)}
.v61-glow-editor label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.v61-glow-editor input[type=checkbox]{width:17px;height:17px;margin:0;accent-color:#1396d1}
.v61-glow-color{width:30px;height:26px;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}
.v61-glow-rate{width:88px;height:24px;margin:0;accent-color:#9b5de5;touch-action:none}
.v61-glow-rate-out{min-width:40px;font-size:9px;font-weight:850;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted)}
.v61-hidden{display:none!important}
body.theme-light .v61-duration-control,body.theme-light .v61-glow-editor{background:#fff;border-color:#9fb8ca}
.timeline-head{overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain;scrollbar-width:thin}
.timeline-head>.timeline-duration{flex:0 0 auto}

/* Smooth Apple Pencil/touch playhead acquisition: a large invisible hit target with a small visible arrow. */
.ruler-playhead{
  top:-11px!important;width:48px!important;height:45px!important;transform:translateX(-24px)!important;
  background:transparent!important;clip-path:none!important;touch-action:none!important;cursor:ew-resize!important
}
.ruler-playhead:after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:17px;top:11px;width:14px;height:18px;background:#f7d94c;
  clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,50% 100%);filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35));pointer-events:none
}
.ruler-lane{overflow:visible!important;touch-action:none}
.timeline-body,.timeline-grid,.track-lane{touch-action:pan-y}
body.v61-scrubbing .timeline-body,body.v61-scrubbing .timeline-grid,body.v61-scrubbing .track-lane{touch-action:none!important;cursor:ew-resize!important}

/* Marker selector: width dot sits at the lower-right edge. */
#markerSwatch .marker-width-dot{
  position:absolute!important;right:-4px!important;bottom:-4px!important;left:auto!important;top:auto!important;
  background:#fff!important;border-color:var(--marker-color)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.62),0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important
}
.v61-marker-options{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;gap:10px}
.v61-marker-group{display:grid;gap:5px}
.v61-marker-group>span{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.v61-segmented{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v61-segmented button{min-height:34px;padding:5px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);font-size:10px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}
.v61-segmented button.active{background:#0b73b7;color:#fff;border-color:#39bdf2;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.v61-marker-hint{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}
.v61-snap-preview{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.8))}

/* Pinch zoom feedback. */
#rinkFrame.v61-zoomed:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border:2px solid rgba(40,169,226,.28);border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:29}
.v61-zoom-reset{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:29;min-height:34px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(6,24,39,.82);color:#fff;font:800 10px/1 inherit;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25);pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer}
.v61-zoom-reset[hidden]{display:none!important}

/* Dashed/dotted drawing styles stay crisp at all zoom levels. */
.v61-drawing-path{vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}

@media(max-width:1080px){
  .v61-duration-control{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(105px,150px) auto}.v61-duration-control input[type=range]{width:clamp(105px,14vw,150px)}
  .v61-speed-readout{display:none}.v61-glow-rate{width:68px}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .v61-timeline-editor{gap:4px}.v61-duration-control{padding:2px 5px;grid-template-columns:minmax(95px,125px) auto}.v61-duration-control>span{display:none}.v61-duration-control input[type=range]{width:clamp(95px,25vw,125px)}
  .v61-glow-editor{padding:2px 5px}.v61-glow-editor label span{display:none}.v61-glow-rate{width:58px}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .v60-float-button{min-height:39px!important;padding:7px 12px!important;font-size:11px!important}
  .v61-duration-control input[type=range]{width:100px}
}



/* Version 6.2 — direct-manipulation timeline sliders and unified floating actions. */
:root{
  --v62-floating-action-width:88px;
  --v62-floating-action-height:42px;
}

/* Every temporary rink action uses the same modern rounded-rectangle footprint. */
.v60-float-button,
.v60-mode-cancel,
.v60-shot-actions button{
  inline-size:var(--v62-floating-action-width)!important;
  min-inline-size:var(--v62-floating-action-width)!important;
  max-inline-size:var(--v62-floating-action-width)!important;
  block-size:var(--v62-floating-action-height)!important;
  min-block-size:var(--v62-floating-action-height)!important;
  max-block-size:var(--v62-floating-action-height)!important;
  padding:0 9px!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;
  display:inline-flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
  line-height:1.05!important;
  text-align:center!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
}
.v60-shot-actions .v61-shot-secondary{margin-right:0!important}

/* A larger, Pencil-friendly timeline range surface with a clearly grabbable thumb. */
.v61-duration-control{
  grid-template-columns:auto minmax(176px,250px) auto!important;
  min-height:44px!important;
  padding:3px 9px!important;
}
.v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]{
  -webkit-appearance:none!important;
  appearance:none!important;
  width:clamp(176px,19vw,250px)!important;
  height:40px!important;
  min-height:40px!important;
  margin:-4px 0!important;
  padding:0!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  outline:0!important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(to right,
      #148ac5 0,
      #148ac5 var(--v62-range-progress,0%),
      color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 78%,transparent) var(--v62-range-progress,0%),
      color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 78%,transparent) 100%) center/100% 8px no-repeat!important;
  cursor:ew-resize!important;
  touch-action:none!important;
  user-select:none!important;
  -webkit-user-select:none!important;
}
.v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  height:8px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  background:transparent!important;
}
.v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none!important;
  appearance:none!important;
  width:24px!important;
  height:24px!important;
  margin-top:-8px!important;
  border:3px solid #eaf8ff!important;
  border-radius:50%!important;
  background:#148ac5!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(5,37,57,.55),0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important;
  cursor:grab!important;
}
.v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]::-moz-range-track{
  height:8px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  background:transparent!important;
}
.v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]::-moz-range-progress{
  height:8px!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  background:#148ac5!important;
}
.v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:20px!important;
  height:20px!important;
  border:3px solid #eaf8ff!important;
  border-radius:50%!important;
  background:#148ac5!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(5,37,57,.55),0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)!important;
  cursor:grab!important;
}
.v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]:focus-visible{
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(57,216,255,.42)!important;
}
body.v62-range-dragging,
body.v62-range-dragging *{
  cursor:ew-resize!important;
  user-select:none!important;
  -webkit-user-select:none!important;
}
body.v62-range-dragging .timeline-head{touch-action:none!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important}
body.v62-range-dragging .v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]::-webkit-slider-thumb{cursor:grabbing!important;transform:scale(1.08)}
body.v62-range-dragging .v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]::-moz-range-thumb{cursor:grabbing!important;transform:scale(1.08)}

@media(max-width:700px){
  .v61-duration-control{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(160px,210px) auto!important}
  .v61-duration-control input[type="range"][data-v61-role]{width:clamp(160px,42vw,210px)!important}
}
@media(max-width:340px){
  :root{--v62-floating-action-width:74px;--v62-floating-action-height:40px}
}


/* Version 6.3 — timeline glow intervals and recordable telestration */
.v63-telestration-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:34px;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid #35536b;border-radius:9px;background:#10283e;color:#edf6fb;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto;user-select:none}
.v63-telestration-toggle input{width:18px;height:18px;margin:0;accent-color:#1e78aa}
.v63-telestration-toggle>span:last-child{display:grid;line-height:1.05}.v63-telestration-toggle strong{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em}.v63-telestration-toggle small{margin-top:3px;color:#9bb2c3;font-size:9px;font-weight:750}
.v63-telestration-icon{font-size:16px;line-height:1;color:#39d8ff}
.v63-glow-track,.v63-glow-track>.track-label,.v63-glow-track>.track-lane{min-height:47px}
.v63-glow-track .movement-clip{top:18px;height:24px}.v63-puck-glow-track .puck-event{top:3px}.v63-puck-glow-track .travel-span{top:30px}.v63-puck-glow-track .v63-glow-clip{top:35px}
.v63-glow-clip{position:absolute;top:3px;height:10px;min-width:22px;padding:0 5px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-glow-color,#39d8ff) 74%,#fff);border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-glow-color,#39d8ff) 76%,transparent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-glow-color,#39d8ff) 40%,transparent));box-shadow:0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-glow-color,#39d8ff) 65%,transparent);color:#fff;font:900 7px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;z-index:9}
.v63-glow-clip.blink{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-glow-color,#39d8ff) 86%,transparent) 0 7px,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 7px 12px)}
.v63-glow-clip.selected{outline:2px solid #f7d94c;outline-offset:1px}
.v63-telestration-row,.v63-telestration-row>.track-label,.v63-telestration-row>.track-lane{height:auto}.v63-telestration-row.disabled{opacity:.62}
.v63-telestration-row .track-label{display:grid;grid-template-columns:12px minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;column-gap:7px;align-content:center}.v63-telestration-row .track-label .track-dot{grid-row:1/3}.v63-telestration-row .track-label strong{align-self:end}.v63-telestration-row .track-label small{align-self:start;color:#8ca7ba;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em}
.v63-ink-dot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b 0 45%,#39d8ff 46% 100%);border-color:#fff!important}
.v63-telestration-lane{position:relative}.v63-telestration-clip{position:absolute;height:22px;min-width:28px;padding:2px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72);border-radius:7px;color:#fff;font:900 8px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.07em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;cursor:pointer;z-index:8;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.v63-telestration-clip.draw{background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-ink-color,#39d8ff) 72%,#10283e),color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-ink-color,#39d8ff) 48%,#17364f))}.v63-telestration-clip.erase{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#9f2938 0 7px,#6e1d2a 7px 14px)}
.v63-telestration-clip.selected{outline:2px solid #f7d94c;outline-offset:1px}
.v63-glow-editor{position:relative}.v63-glow-time{font-size:8px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#a8becc;white-space:nowrap}
.v63-erase-playback{stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.74);stroke-width:34;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(57,216,255,.4));pointer-events:none}
.v63-timeline-focus{pointer-events:none}
body.theme-light .v63-telestration-toggle{background:#e9f1f7;border-color:#9eb4c5;color:#0b2f55}.theme-light .v63-telestration-toggle small,.theme-light .v63-glow-time{color:#5d7689}
body.theme-light .v63-glow-clip{color:#071827;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--v63-glow-color,#39d8ff) 60%,#0b2f55)}
body.theme-light .v63-telestration-clip{border-color:rgba(10,35,55,.45)}
@media(max-width:900px){.v63-telestration-toggle strong{display:none}.v63-telestration-toggle{padding:4px 7px}.v63-telestration-toggle small{font-size:8px}.v63-glow-time{display:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v63-glow-clip{box-shadow:none}}

.ownership-card a{color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
.ownership-card a:hover,.ownership-card a:focus-visible{text-decoration:underline}
</style>

<style id="v64Styles">
/* Version 6.4 — clearer live shot projection and subtle ricochet feedback. */
.goalie-token-number{font-size:15px;font-weight:950;dominant-baseline:middle;alignment-baseline:middle;paint-order:stroke;stroke:rgba(0,0,0,.18);stroke-width:1px;pointer-events:none}
.v64-shot-aim-live,.v64-shot-projection{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none}
.v64-shot-aim-live{stroke:#cc2c40;stroke-width:2.45;stroke-dasharray:8 8;opacity:.92;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.9))}
.v64-shot-projection{stroke:#aeb8c2;stroke-width:2.25;stroke-dasharray:7 9;opacity:.78;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.14))}
.v64-shot-contact{fill:#fff;stroke:#cc2c40;stroke-width:2.1;pointer-events:none}
.v64-shot-bounce{fill:#fff;stroke:#8a96a1;stroke-width:1.7;opacity:.9;pointer-events:none}
body.theme-dark .v64-shot-projection{stroke:#c6d0d8;opacity:.72}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v64-shot-aim-live,.v64-shot-projection{stroke-dashoffset:0!important}}
</style>

<style id="v65Styles">
/* Version 6.5 — reliable playback glow, duration-width puck actions, and a
   conditional telestration track. */
.v65-timeline-glow{
  will-change:filter;
  transition:filter .055s linear;
}
.puck-event.v65-puck-action-clip{
  top:4px!important;
  height:28px!important;
  min-width:34px!important;
  transform:none!important;
  border-radius:8px!important;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-start;
  overflow:hidden;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  padding:4px 8px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.34),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.puck-event.v65-puck-action-clip.passSpace{
  background:#195b82;
}
.puck-event.v65-puck-action-clip::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:auto 5px 3px 5px;
  height:2px;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.travel-span.v65-replaced-travel-span{
  display:none!important;
}
/* The row is removed from the DOM while Static mode is selected. This rule is
   a defensive fallback for saved or browser-restored markup. */
.v63-telestration-row.v65-static-hidden{
  display:none!important;
}
body.theme-light .puck-event.v65-puck-action-clip{
  color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(9,35,57,.2),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.24);
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .v65-timeline-glow{transition:none}
}
</style>

</head>
<body class="theme-light left-hidden right-hidden timeline-hidden">
<header class="topbar">
  <div class="brand"><img id="brandLogo" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="BOTD dog tag logo"><div class="brand-copy"><strong>BOTD Hockey Coaching Aid</strong><span>Hockey Playbook Studio · Version 6.8</span></div></div>
  <div class="topbar-spacer"></div><div class="top-status" id="topStatus">Empty board · build movement first, then direct the puck.</div>
  <button class="btn small" id="newBoardBtn">New</button><button class="btn small" id="savePlayTopBtn">Save play</button>
  <button class="icon-btn" id="focusBtn" title="Full-screen focus">⛶</button>
</header>
<div class="workspace">
  <aside class="left-drawer open" id="leftDrawer">
    <div class="drawer-head"><div><h2>Board Setup</h2><p>Teams, roster, settings, and playbook</p></div></div>
    <nav class="tabs" aria-label="Setup tabs">
      <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="teams">TEAMS</button><button class="tab-btn" data-tab="roster">ROSTER</button><button class="tab-btn" data-tab="settings">SETTINGS</button><button class="tab-btn" data-tab="playbook">PLAYBOOK</button>
    </nav>
    <div class="drawer-scroll">
      <section class="tab-panel active" id="tab-teams">
        <div class="section-card"><h3>Teams &amp; Rink</h3><p class="help">Edit team identities and colors. Players inherit their team colors unless an individual override is set.</p><div id="teamCards"></div></div>
      </section>
      <section class="tab-panel" id="tab-roster">
        <div class="section-card"><h3>Roster</h3><p class="help">Bench order follows forward lines, defense pairs, goalies, then staff. Select a bench token to place it on the ice.</p><div class="roster-toolbar"><select id="rosterTeamSelect"><option value="A">DAWGS</option><option value="B">FLAMINGOS</option></select><input id="rosterSearch" type="text" placeholder="Search roster"></div><button class="btn small" id="addRosterBtn">+ Add player</button><div class="roster-list" id="rosterList"></div></div>
      </section>
      <section class="tab-panel" id="tab-settings">
        <div class="section-card appearance-card"><h3>Appearance &amp; Language</h3><p class="help">Use a large, USA Hockey-inspired light workspace or a low-glare dark workspace. Language changes are stored on this device.</p><div class="theme-choice" role="group" aria-label="Theme"><button class="btn small primary" id="themeLightBtn" type="button">Light</button><button class="btn small" id="themeDarkBtn" type="button">Dark</button></div><div class="field"><span>Language</span><select id="languageSelect"><option value="en-US">US English</option><option value="en-CA">Canadian English</option><option value="sv">Swedish</option><option value="fi">Finnish</option><option value="ru">Russian</option></select></div><p class="help canadian-note" id="canadianNote" hidden>Canadian English adds a little “eh” and places a maple leaf at center ice.</p></div>
        <div class="section-card"><h3>Token Display</h3><label class="check-row"><span>Names</span><input id="showNames" type="checkbox"></label><label class="check-row"><span>Numbers</span><input id="showNumbers" type="checkbox" checked></label><label class="check-row"><span>Positions</span><input id="showPositions" type="checkbox" checked></label><label class="check-row"><span>Leadership</span><input id="showLeadership" type="checkbox"></label><label class="check-row"><span>Offside light</span><input id="showOffside" type="checkbox" checked></label></div>
        <div class="section-card"><h3>Center-Ice Logo</h3><p class="help">Half Ice rotates and crops the image to the visible half of center ice.</p><input class="file-input" id="centerLogoInput" type="file" accept="image/*"><div class="field"><span>Opacity</span><input id="logoOpacity" type="range" min="0" max="1" value="0.32" step="0.02"></div><button class="btn small" id="resetCenterLogoBtn">Use BOTD default</button></div>
        <div class="section-card ownership-card"><h3>Ownership &amp; License</h3><p class="help">© 2026 FENRIR LLC. All rights reserved. B.O.T.D. Hockey Playbook Studio is proprietary software.</p><p class="help"><a href="https://botdhockey.com/terms/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a> · <a href="./LICENSE.txt" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Software License</a></p></div>
        <div class="settings-compat-controls" hidden aria-hidden="true"><input id="showRoutes" type="checkbox" checked tabindex="-1"><select id="routeMode" tabindex="-1"><option value="ahead">Ahead; erase behind</option><option value="full">Show all</option><option value="off">Hidden</option></select><input id="durationSetting" type="number" min="4" max="60" step="1" value="12" tabindex="-1"></div>
      </section>
      <section class="tab-panel" id="tab-playbook">
        <div class="section-card"><h3 id="playbookHeading">BOTD Playbook v5</h3><img class="playbook-logo" id="playbookLogo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Playbook logo"><div class="field"><span>Playbook name</span><input id="playbookName" type="text" value="BOTD Playbook v5"></div><input class="file-input" id="playbookLogoInput" type="file" accept="image/*"><div class="button-row"><button class="btn small primary" id="saveCurrentPlayBtn">Save current</button><button class="btn small" id="exportPlaybookBtn">Export JSON</button><button class="btn small" id="importPlaybookBtn">Import JSON</button><input id="importPlaybookFile" type="file" accept="application/json" hidden></div></div>
        <div class="section-card"><h3>New v5 Timeline Templates</h3><p class="help">The Version 4 turn-based library was intentionally replaced. Every template below uses continuous movement tracks and an independent puck route.</p><div id="builtinPlayList"></div></div>
        <div class="section-card"><h3>My Plays</h3><div id="userPlayList"></div></div>
      </section>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <main class="stage">
    <section class="bench-drawer" id="benchDrawer" aria-label="Team benches">
      <button class="bench-drawer-toggle" id="benchDrawerToggle" type="button" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="benchRack" title="Hide team benches">
        <span class="bench-drawer-title">TEAM BENCHES</span><span class="bench-drawer-summary" id="benchDrawerSummary"></span><span class="bench-drawer-state">Hide</span><span class="bench-drawer-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌃</span>
      </button>
      <div class="bench-rack team-benches" id="benchRack"><div class="bench bench-team" id="benchA"></div><div class="bench bench-team" id="benchB"></div></div>
    </section>
    <div class="rink-shell"><div class="rink-frame whole" id="rinkFrame">
      <button class="half-end-pill" id="halfEndPill" type="button" hidden data-side="right" aria-label="Half Ice end: Right" title="Choose the visible Half Ice end"><span class="half-end-pill-thumb" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="half-end-pill-label half-end-pill-left" data-half-pill-side="left">LEFT</span><span class="half-end-pill-label half-end-pill-right" data-half-pill-side="right">RIGHT</span></button><button class="view-badge" id="viewBadge" type="button" aria-label="Switch to Half Ice - Right End" title="Switch to Half Ice - Right End">FULL ICE</button><div class="offside-light" id="offsideLight" title="Onside" aria-label="Onside"></div>
      <div class="live-hud" id="liveHud"><strong>LIVE PUCK DIRECTOR</strong><span>Pass: tap a player or open ice</span></div>
      <div class="goal-banner" id="goalBanner"><div>GOAL!</div></div><div class="action-record-hud" id="actionRecordHud" hidden><strong id="actionRecordHudTitle">TRACE NEW ACTION</strong><span id="actionRecordHudDetail"></span><button id="cancelActionRecordBtn" type="button">Cancel</button></div>
      <svg class="rink-svg" id="rinkSvg" viewBox="0 0 1000 600" role="application" aria-label="Interactive hockey coaching board">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="iceGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f9ffff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#dff2f7"/></linearGradient>
          <pattern id="iceTex" width="28" height="28" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 16 Q8 11 16 16 T32 16" fill="none" stroke="#b9dce6" stroke-width=".7" opacity=".22"/></pattern>
          <clipPath id="fullClip"><rect x="10" y="10" width="980" height="580" rx="82"/></clipPath>
          <clipPath id="halfClip"><rect x="10" y="10" width="580" height="680" rx="72"/></clipPath>
          <clipPath id="halfLogoClip"><rect x="204" y="610" width="192" height="80"/></clipPath>
          <marker id="routeArrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10z" fill="context-stroke"/></marker>
          <marker id="passArrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 Z" fill="#111315"/></marker>
          <marker id="shotArrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 Z" fill="#111315"/><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 5 Z" fill="#e32636"/></marker>
          <filter id="puckShadow" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%"><feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#07101a" flood-opacity=".5"/></filter>
        </defs>
        <g id="fullRink">
          <rect x="10" y="10" width="980" height="580" rx="82" fill="url(#iceGrad)" stroke="#607f91" stroke-width="4"/><rect x="10" y="10" width="980" height="580" rx="82" fill="url(#iceTex)" clip-path="url(#fullClip)"/>
          <g clip-path="url(#fullClip)">
            <line x1="75" y1="10" x2="75" y2="590" stroke="#d74945" stroke-width="5"/><line x1="925" y1="10" x2="925" y2="590" stroke="#d74945" stroke-width="5"/>
            <path d="M10 205L75 225M10 395L75 375M925 225L990 205M925 375L990 395" fill="none" stroke="#d74945" stroke-width="2.5"/>
            <line x1="330" y1="10" x2="330" y2="590" stroke="#1265b0" stroke-width="11"/><line x1="670" y1="10" x2="670" y2="590" stroke="#1265b0" stroke-width="11"/><line x1="500" y1="10" x2="500" y2="590" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M488 10v580M512 10v580" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".7"/>
            <circle cx="500" cy="300" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="500" cy="300" r="6" fill="#1265b0"/>
            <g fill="none" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="3"><circle cx="180" cy="170" r="66"/><circle cx="180" cy="430" r="66"/><circle cx="820" cy="170" r="66"/><circle cx="820" cy="430" r="66"/></g>
            <g fill="#d74641"><circle cx="180" cy="170" r="6"/><circle cx="180" cy="430" r="6"/><circle cx="820" cy="170" r="6"/><circle cx="820" cy="430" r="6"/><circle cx="410" cy="170" r="6"/><circle cx="410" cy="430" r="6"/><circle cx="590" cy="170" r="6"/><circle cx="590" cy="430" r="6"/></g>
            <path d="M75 252A48 48 0 0 1 75 348L75 300Z" fill="#b8e1f1" fill-opacity=".7" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M925 252A48 48 0 0 0 925 348L925 300Z" fill="#b8e1f1" fill-opacity=".7" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="3"/>
            <path d="M49 257h26v86H49q-16-43 0-86z" fill="none" stroke="#49687a" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M951 257h-26v86h26q16-43 0-86z" fill="none" stroke="#49687a" stroke-width="4"/>
          </g><rect x="10" y="10" width="980" height="580" rx="82" fill="none" stroke="#456171" stroke-width="4"/>
          <image id="centerLogoFull" href="" x="404" y="204" width="192" height="192" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" opacity=".32" clip-path="url(#fullClip)"/>
          <g id="canadaLeafFull" class="canada-leaf" transform="translate(500 300) scale(.92)" display="none"><path d="M0-63 12-37 29-47 25-23 51-14 35 1 48 19 20 16 15 43 5 34 0 66-5 34-15 43-20 16-48 19-35 1-51-14-25-23-29-47-12-37Z"/></g>
        </g>
        <g id="halfRink" display="none">
          <rect x="10" y="10" width="580" height="680" rx="72" fill="url(#iceGrad)" stroke="#607f91" stroke-width="4"/><rect x="10" y="10" width="580" height="680" rx="72" fill="url(#iceTex)" clip-path="url(#halfClip)"/>
          <g clip-path="url(#halfClip)"><line x1="10" y1="105" x2="590" y2="105" stroke="#d74945" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M205 10L225 105M395 10L375 105" fill="none" stroke="#d74945" stroke-width="2.5"/><line x1="10" y1="430" x2="590" y2="430" stroke="#1265b0" stroke-width="11"/><line x1="10" y1="688" x2="590" y2="688" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="300" cy="688" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="300" cy="688" r="6" fill="#1265b0"/><g fill="none" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="3"><circle cx="175" cy="285" r="66"/><circle cx="425" cy="285" r="66"/></g><g fill="#d74641"><circle cx="175" cy="285" r="6"/><circle cx="425" cy="285" r="6"/><circle cx="175" cy="555" r="6"/><circle cx="425" cy="555" r="6"/></g><path d="M245 105A55 55 0 0 1 355 105L300 105Z" fill="#b8e1f1" fill-opacity=".72" stroke="#d74641" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M258 105V65Q300 43 342 65V105" fill="none" stroke="#49687a" stroke-width="4"/></g>
          <rect x="10" y="10" width="580" height="680" rx="72" fill="none" stroke="#456171" stroke-width="4"/>
          <g clip-path="url(#halfLogoClip)" opacity=".32" id="centerLogoHalfGroup"><image id="centerLogoHalf" href="" x="204" y="594" width="192" height="192" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" transform="rotate(90 300 690)"/></g>
          <g id="canadaLeafHalf" class="canada-leaf" transform="translate(300 646) scale(.55)" display="none"><path d="M0-63 12-37 29-47 25-23 51-14 35 1 48 19 20 16 15 43 5 34 0 66-5 34-15 43-20 16-48 19-35 1-51-14-25-23-29-47-12-37Z"/></g>
        </g>
        <g id="drawingLayer"></g><g id="routeLayer"></g><g id="previewLayer"></g><g id="objectLayer"></g><g id="puckLayer"></g><g id="targetLayer"></g>
      </svg>
      <div class="v60-context-layer" id="v60ContextLayer" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="v60-context-menu" id="v60ContextMenu" hidden></div>
        <div class="v60-shot-panel" id="v60ShotPanel" hidden>
          <div class="v60-shot-heading"><span>SHOT POWER</span><output for="v60ShotPower">70%</output></div>

<div class="command-bar" id="commandBar">
  <button class="tool-btn active" data-tool="select" title="Select (V)">↖</button><button class="tool-btn" data-tool="draw" title="Pencil (D)">✎</button><button class="tool-btn" data-tool="erase" title="Erase (E)">⌫</button><button class="tool-btn marker-swatch" id="markerSwatch" title="Marker color and width" aria-label="Marker color and width"><span class="marker-width-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span></button>
  <div class="separator"></div><button class="tool-btn" id="undoBtn" title="Undo timeline edit">↶</button><button class="tool-btn" id="redoBtn" title="Redo timeline edit">↷</button><button class="tool-btn" id="clearDrawingBtn" title="Clear telestration">⌦</button>
  <button class="tool-btn legacy-step-control" id="stepBackBtn" hidden aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">−</button><button class="tool-btn legacy-step-control" id="stepForwardBtn" hidden aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">+</button>
  <div class="command-spacer"></div>
  <div class="toolbar-playback" id="toolbarPlayback" role="group" aria-label="Playback controls">
    <button class="transport" id="jumpStartBtn" title="Go to start" aria-label="Go to start">⏮</button><button class="transport" id="rewindBtn" title="Rewind 1 second" aria-label="Rewind 1 second">⏪</button><button class="transport" id="prevActionBtn" title="Previous action" aria-label="Previous action">◀│</button><button class="transport" id="stepBackSmallBtn" title="Step back 0.1 seconds" aria-label="Step back 0.1 seconds">−.1</button><button class="transport primary" id="playBtn" title="Play or pause" aria-label="Play or pause">▶</button><button class="transport" id="stepForwardSmallBtn" title="Step forward 0.1 seconds" aria-label="Step forward 0.1 seconds">+.1</button><button class="transport" id="nextActionBtn" title="Next action" aria-label="Next action">│▶</button><button class="transport" id="jumpEndBtn" title="Go to end" aria-label="Go to end">⏭</button>
    <select id="playSpeed" class="toolbar-speed" title="Playback speed" aria-label="Playback speed"><option value=".25">0.25×</option><option value=".5">0.5×</option><option value=".75">0.75×</option><option value="1" selected>1×</option><option value="1.5">1.5×</option><option value="2">2×</option><option value="3">3×</option></select><span class="time-code" id="timeCode" aria-live="off">0:00.0 / 0:12.0</span>
  </div>
  <label class="route-toggle"><input id="toolbarRoutes" type="checkbox" checked><span>Routes</span></label><select id="toolbarRouteMode"><option value="ahead">Ahead</option><option value="full">All</option><option value="off">Hidden</option></select><button class="tool-btn" id="timelineToggleBtn" title="Show or hide timeline">⌁</button><button class="tool-btn" id="fullscreenBottomBtn" title="Full-screen focus">⛶</button>
</div>

<section class="timeline-dock" id="timelineDock" aria-label="Single continuous timeline">
  <div class="timeline-head">
    <span class="timeline-title">SINGLE TIMELINE</span>
    <div class="v60-timeline-context" id="v60TimelineContext" hidden></div>
    <button class="action-change-pill" id="changeActionAtPlayheadBtn" type="button" hidden title="Move the selected player from the exact playhead frame"><span aria-hidden="true">✎</span><span class="action-context-label">Move</span><span class="action-context-name"></span><span class="action-context-time">0:00.0</span></button>
    <div class="timeline-duration"><span>Length</span><input id="timelineLength" type="number" min="4" max="60" step="1" value="12"><span>s</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline-branchbar" aria-label="Timeline play options, puck routes, and reusable range">
    <div class="variation-cluster"><span class="branch-label">PLAY OPTION</span><select id="timelineVariationSelect" aria-label="Active play option"></select><button class="btn small danger" id="deleteVariationBtn" type="button">Delete option</button></div>
    <div class="puck-route-cluster"><span class="branch-label">PUCK ROUTE</span><select id="timelineTakeSelect" aria-label="Active puck route" title="Active puck route"></select><button class="btn small" id="newPuckTakeBtn" type="button">+ Puck route</button></div>
    <div class="reuse-cluster"><output id="reuseRangeOutput" class="reuse-output">Set In and Out to choose a reusable segment</output><button class="btn small" id="setReuseInBtn" type="button">Set In</button><button class="btn small" id="setReuseOutBtn" type="button">Set Out</button><button class="btn small primary" id="copyReuseBtn" type="button" disabled>Copy &amp; Reuse</button></div>
  </div>
  <div class="timeline-body" id="timelineBody"><div class="timeline-grid" id="timelineGrid"></div></div>
</section>

function hexToRgb(hex){const h=String(hex).replace("#","").trim();const n=parseInt(h.length===3?h.split("").map(c=>c+c).join(""):h,16);return Number.isFinite(n)?{r:(n>>16)&255,g:(n>>8)&255,b:n&255}:{r:0,g:0,b:0}}
function rgbToHex(r,g,b){return "#"+[r,g,b].map(v=>clamp(Math.round(Number(v)||0),0,255).toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("").toUpperCase()}
function contrastText(hex){const {r,g,b}=hexToRgb(hex);return (r*299+g*587+b*114)/1000>150?"#08131e":"#ffffff"}
function polylineLength(points){let total=0;for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)total+=dist(points[i-1],points[i]);return total}
function pointAtPolyline(points,progress){if(!points?.length)return{x:0,y:0};if(points.length===1)return{x:points[0].x,y:points[0].y};const total=polylineLength(points);if(total<.001)return{x:points[0].x,y:points[0].y};let target=clamp(progress,0,1)*total,walk=0;for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){const seg=dist(points[i-1],points[i]);if(walk+seg>=target)return pointLerp(points[i-1],points[i],seg?((target-walk)/seg):0);walk+=seg}return{x:points.at(-1).x,y:points.at(-1).y}}
function pathD(points){return points?.length?points.map((p,i)=>`${i?"L":"M"}${round(p.x,1)} ${round(p.y,1)}`).join(" "):""}
function pathPositionByDistance(points,distance){if(!points?.length)return{x:0,y:0};if(points.length===1)return points[0];let left=Math.max(0,distance);for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){const l=dist(points[i-1],points[i]);if(left<=l)return pointLerp(points[i-1],points[i],l?left/l:0);left-=l}return points.at(-1)}
function segmentCircleHit(a,b,c,r){const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(!len2)return null;const t=clamp(((c.x-a.x)*dx+(c.y-a.y)*dy)/len2,0,1);const p={x:a.x+t*dx,y:a.y+t*dy};if(dist(p,c)<=r)return{t,point:p};return null}
function lineIntersection(a,b,c,d){const den=(a.x-b.x)*(c.y-d.y)-(a.y-b.y)*(c.x-d.x);if(Math.abs(den)<1e-8)return null;const x=((a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x)*(c.x-d.x)-(a.x-b.x)*(c.x*d.y-c.y*d.x))/den;const y=((a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x)*(c.y-d.y)-(a.y-b.y)*(c.x*d.y-c.y*d.x))/den;const ta=Math.abs(b.x-a.x)>Math.abs(b.y-a.y)?(x-a.x)/(b.x-a.x||1):(y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y||1);const tb=Math.abs(d.x-c.x)>Math.abs(d.y-c.y)?(x-c.x)/(d.x-c.x||1):(y-c.y)/(d.y-c.y||1);return{point:{x,y},ta,tb}}
function download(name,text,type="application/octet-stream"){const blob=text instanceof Blob?text:new Blob([text],{type});const a=document.createElement("a");a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000)}
function fileToDataUrl(file,max=1000){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const reader=new FileReader();reader.onerror=reject;reader.onload=()=>{const img=new Image();img.onerror=()=>resolve(reader.result);img.onload=()=>{const scale=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(img.width,img.height));const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.width*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.height*scale));canvas.getContext("2d").drawImage(img,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);resolve(canvas.toDataURL("image/png",.9))};img.src=reader.result};reader.readAsDataURL(file)})}
let toastTimer=0;function toast(message,ms=2600){const el=$("#toast");el.textContent=message;el.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("show"),ms)}

const DEFAULT_WHOLE_LINEUP={
  A_2:{x:465,y:300},A_1:{x:465,y:210},A_3:{x:465,y:390},A_13:{x:380,y:235},A_14:{x:380,y:365},A_19:{x:62,y:300},A_21:{x:455,y:64},A_22:{x:390,y:64},

};
function createCanonicalLineup(view="whole"){
  const lineup=deepClone(DEFAULT_WHOLE_LINEUP);
  if(view!=="half")return lineup;
  const mapped={};
  for(const [id,p] of Object.entries(lineup))mapped[id]={x:clamp(50+p.x*.5,26,574),y:clamp(40+p.y*1.05,26,674)};
  return mapped
}
function slicePolylineByProgress(points,p0=0,p1=1){
  const pts=(Array.isArray(points)?points:[]).filter(p=>Number.isFinite(Number(p?.x))&&Number.isFinite(Number(p?.y))).map(p=>({x:Number(p.x),y:Number(p.y)}));

function normalizedReuseRange(){

function renderVariationControls(){

  if(select){select.innerHTML=(state.variations||[]).map(v=>`<option value="${escapeHtml(v.id)}">${escapeHtml(v.name)}</option>`).join("");select.value=state.activeVariationId||""}

function copyAndReuseRange(){

  state.variations.push(newOption);state.activeVariationId=id;applyVariation(newOption);ui.playhead=clamp(segment,0,state.timeline.duration);ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;ui.reuseRange={start:null,end:null};stopPlayback();renderAll();

function decorateInspectorV52(){

function setupV52Events(){

  });
}

function loadPlay(play){
  pushHistory();stopPlayback();
  if(Array.isArray(play?.variations)&&play.variations.length){state.variations=play.variations.map((v,i)=>normalizeVariation(v,i,play));state.activeVariationId=state.variations.some(v=>v.id===play.activeVariationId)?play.activeVariationId:state.variations[0].id;applyVariation(state.variations.find(v=>v.id===state.activeVariationId))}
  else{
    state.view=play.view==="half"?"half":"whole";state.onIce=deepClone(play.onIce||{});state.puckStart=deepClone(play.puckStart||{x:500,y:300});state.timeline=normalizeTimelineData(play.timeline||{duration:play.duration,movements:play.movements,puckTakes:play.puckTakes,activeTakeId:play.puckTakes?.[0]?.id});state.drawings=deepClone(play.drawings||[]);const id=uid("option");state.activeVariationId=id;state.variations=[captureVariationFromStateLike(state,id,"Option 1")]
  }
  ui.playhead=0;ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;ui.reuseRange={start:null,end:null};renderAll();scheduleSave();toast(`Loaded ${play.name}`)
}

let rinkFitRaf=0,timelineResizeWidth=0;
function applyAppearance(){
  const theme=state.appearance?.theme==="dark"?"dark":"light";document.body.classList.toggle("theme-light",theme==="light");document.body.classList.toggle("theme-dark",theme==="dark");
  const lang=currentLanguage();document.documentElement.lang=lang==="en-US"||lang==="en-CA"?"en":lang;const meta=$("#themeColorMeta");if(meta)meta.content=theme==="light"?"#F3F7FB":"#061423";
  const canadian=lang==="en-CA";for(const id of ["#canadaLeafFull","#canadaLeafHalf"]){const el=$(id);if(el)el.style.display=canadian?"inline":"none"}const note=$("#canadianNote");if(note)note.hidden=!canadian;
}
function fitRink(){
  cancelAnimationFrame(rinkFitRaf);rinkFitRaf=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const shell=$(".rink-shell"),frame=$("#rinkFrame");if(!shell||!frame)return;const sw=Math.max(0,shell.clientWidth-2),sh=Math.max(0,shell.clientHeight-2);if(sw<40||sh<40)return;const ratio=state.view==="half"?600/700:1000/600;let w=sw,h=w/ratio;if(h>sh){h=sh;w=h*ratio}frame.style.width=`${Math.floor(w)}px`;frame.style.height=`${Math.floor(h)}px`});
}
function updateDrawerHandles(){
  const leftHidden=document.body.classList.contains("left-hidden"),rightHidden=document.body.classList.contains("right-hidden"),timelineHidden=document.body.classList.contains("timeline-hidden"),lh=$("#leftDrawerHandle"),rh=$("#rightDrawerHandle");
  if(lh)lh.textContent=leftHidden?"›":"‹";if(rh)rh.textContent=rightHidden?"‹":"›";
  const tt=$("#timelineToggleBtn");if(tt){tt.textContent=timelineHidden?"⌃":"⌄";tt.classList.toggle("active",!timelineHidden);tt.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(!timelineHidden))}
  const handle=$("#timelineDrawerHandle");if(handle){handle.classList.toggle("active",!timelineHidden);handle.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(!timelineHidden));const stateLabel=$(".timeline-pill-state",handle),chevron=$(".timeline-pill-chevron",handle);if(stateLabel)stateLabel.textContent=timelineHidden?"Open":"Hide";if(chevron)chevron.textContent=timelineHidden?"⌃":"⌄"}
  applyStaticTranslations()
}
function setTimelineVisible(visible){document.body.classList.toggle("timeline-hidden",!visible);document.body.classList.remove("timeline-collapsed");updateDrawerHandles();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{fitRink();if(visible)renderTimeline()})}
function toggleRight(open){const drawer=$("#rightDrawer");if(open===undefined)open=document.body.classList.contains("right-hidden")||drawer.classList.contains("closed");document.body.classList.toggle("right-hidden",!open);drawer.classList.toggle("closed",!open);drawer.classList.toggle("open",open);updateDrawerHandles();requestAnimationFrame(fitRink)}
function setupLayoutObservers(){
  const ro=new ResizeObserver(entries=>{fitRink();const body=$("#timelineBody");if(body&&Math.abs(body.clientWidth-timelineResizeWidth)>2&&!document.body.classList.contains("timeline-hidden")){timelineResizeWidth=body.clientWidth;renderTimeline()}});const shell=$(".rink-shell"),timeline=$("#timelineBody");if(shell)ro.observe(shell);if(timeline)ro.observe(timeline);window.addEventListener("resize",()=>{fitRink();if(!document.body.classList.contains("timeline-hidden"))renderTimeline()});
}
function setGlowStyle(node,glow,defaultColor){if(!node||!glow?.enabled)return;const color=glow.color||defaultColor||"#39D8FF",size=4+(Number(glow.brightness)||65)/8;node.style.setProperty("--glow-color",color);node.style.setProperty("--glow-size",`${size}px`);node.style.setProperty("--blink",`${1/Math.max(.2,Number(glow.rate)||1.2)}s`);if(glow.blink!==false)node.classList.add("player-glow");else node.classList.add("puck-glow-static")}

  $("#showNames").checked=state.display.names;$("#showNumbers").checked=state.display.numbers;$("#showPositions").checked=state.display.positions;$("#showLeadership").checked=state.display.leadership;$("#showOffside").checked=state.display.offside;$("#logoOpacity").value=state.logoOpacity;$("#showRoutes").checked=state.display.routes;$("#routeMode").value=state.display.routeMode;$("#durationSetting").value=state.timeline.duration;$("#toolbarRoutes").checked=state.display.routes;$("#toolbarRouteMode").value=state.display.routeMode;$("#timelineLength").value=state.timeline.duration;$("#markerSwatch").style.background=state.marker.color;
  const theme=state.appearance?.theme||"light";$("#themeLightBtn").classList.toggle("primary",theme==="light");$("#themeDarkBtn").classList.toggle("primary",theme==="dark");$("#languageSelect").value=currentLanguage();applyStaticTranslations()

function renderBenches(){
  for(const teamId of ["A","B"]){
    const root=$(teamId==="A"?"#benchA":"#benchB"),team=teamById(teamId),bench=state.rosters[teamId].filter(p=>!state.onIce[p.id]).sort(rosterSort);
    root.innerHTML=`<div class="bench-label"><strong>${escapeHtml(team.name)}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(t("onBench",{count:bench.length}))}</span></div>`;
    for(const p of bench){
      const c=playerColors(p),tok=document.createElement("button"),roleClass=p.role==="goalie"?"goalie":p.role==="coach"||p.role==="manager"?"staff":"skater";
      const lineText=p.role==="skater"?(p.position==="LD"||p.position==="RD"?`D Pair ${p.line} · ${p.position}`:`F Line ${p.line} · ${p.position}`):p.role==="goalie"?"Goalie":p.role==="coach"?"Head Coach":"Manager";
      const badge=p.role==="coach"?"HC":p.role==="manager"?"MGR":p.role==="goalie"?(p.number||"G"):(p.number||p.position);
      tok.className=`bench-token bench-card ${roleClass}`;tok.dataset.benchPlayer=p.id;tok.title=t("placeOnIce",{name:p.name});tok.style.setProperty("--piece-primary",c.primary);tok.style.setProperty("--piece-trim",c.trim);tok.style.setProperty("--piece-ink",contrastText(c.primary));
      tok.innerHTML=`<span class="bench-piece"><span>${escapeHtml(badge)}</span></span><span class="bench-card-copy"><strong>${escapeHtml(p.name||"Blank token")}</strong><small>${p.number?`#${escapeHtml(p.number)} · `:""}${escapeHtml(p.position)}${p.hand?` · ${escapeHtml(p.hand)}`:""}</small><em>${escapeHtml(lineText)}</em></span>`;root.appendChild(tok)
    }
  }
}

function renderObjectLayer(time){
  const layer=$("#objectLayer");layer.innerHTML="";
  const addBadge=(group,label,x,y)=>{const badge=svgEl("g",{class:"token-role-badge"});badge.append(svgEl("circle",{cx:x,cy:y,r:11,fill:"#f8fbfd",stroke:"#7890a2","stroke-width":2}));const text=svgEl("text",{x,y,"text-anchor":"middle","dominant-baseline":"central",class:"token-role-text"});text.textContent=label;badge.append(text);group.append(badge)};
  for(const id of Object.keys(state.onIce)){
    const p=playerById(id);if(!p)continue;const pos=playerPositionAt(id,time),colors=playerColors(p),g=svgEl("g",{"data-player-id":id,role:"button","aria-label":p.name,tabindex:"0",transform:`translate(${round(pos.x,2)} ${round(pos.y,2)})`,style:"cursor:pointer"});setGlowStyle(g,p.glow,colors.primary);
    const token=svgEl("g",{class:`ice-token ice-token-${p.role}`});
    if(p.role==="goalie"){
      token.append(svgEl("rect",{x:-24,y:-30,width:48,height:60,rx:8,fill:colors.primary,stroke:colors.trim,"stroke-width":6}));
      token.append(svgEl("path",{d:"M-13 -22V22M0 -22V22M13 -22V22",fill:"none",stroke:colors.trim,"stroke-width":3.5,"stroke-linecap":"round"}));
      if(state.display.numbers&&p.number){const number=svgEl("text",{class:"token-number goalie-token-number",x:0,y:0,dy:".1em","text-anchor":"middle","dominant-baseline":"middle",fill:contrastText(colors.primary)});number.textContent=p.number;token.append(number)}

    layer.append(g)
  }
}
function renderPuckLayer(time,puckTimeline){

  const spinner=svgEl("g",{class:ps.spin&&ui.playing?"puck-spin":""});spinner.append(svgEl("ellipse",{cx:0,cy:2,rx:11,ry:6,fill:"#07090b",stroke:"#5f6970","stroke-width":2,filter:"url(#puckShadow)"}));spinner.append(svgEl("path",{d:"M-7 0Q0-4 7 0",fill:"none",stroke:"#a6afb5","stroke-width":1.4,opacity:.7}));outer.append(spinner);

function timelinePx(){const body=$("#timelineBody"),label=window.innerWidth<=720?104:window.innerWidth<=1180?132:158;const available=Math.max(180,(body?.clientWidth||window.innerWidth)-label-2);return available/Math.max(1,state.timeline.duration)}

function setPlayhead(time,{render=true}={}){ui.playhead=clamp(Number(time)||0,0,state.timeline.duration);if(render)renderFrame(ui.playhead);updateTimelinePlayhead();if(ui.selectedType)renderInspector()}
