let audioCtx=null;function audioContext(){try{return audioCtx||(audioCtx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)())}catch{return null}}
function goalSiren(){const ctx=audioContext();if(!ctx)return;const now=ctx.currentTime;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const osc=ctx.createOscillator(),gain=ctx.createGain();osc.type="sawtooth";osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(520,now+i*.22);osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(760,now+i*.22+.18);gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,now+i*.22);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.09,now+i*.22+.02);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+i*.22+.2);osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);osc.start(now+i*.22);osc.stop(now+i*.22+.21)}}
function tick(ts){if(!ui.playing)return;if(!ui.lastFrame)ui.lastFrame=ts;const prev=ui.playhead,dt=Math.min(.08,(ts-ui.lastFrame)/1000)*ui.speed;ui.lastFrame=ts;ui.playhead+=dt;if(ui.playhead>=state.timeline.duration){ui.playhead=state.timeline.duration;stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});return}const pt=buildPuckTimeline();for(const int of pt.intervals){if(int.goal&&prev<int.end&&ui.playhead>=int.end){goalSiren();ui.liveGoalEvent=int.eventId}}renderFrame(ui.playhead);ui.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}

function jumpAction(direction){const times=eventTimes();if(direction<0){const t=[...times].reverse().find(v=>v<ui.playhead-.03);setPlayhead(t??0)}else{const t=times.find(v=>v>ui.playhead+.03);setPlayhead(t??state.timeline.duration)}}

  if(state.onIce[playerId])return;const p=playerById(playerId);if(!p)return;pushHistory();const index=Object.keys(state.onIce).filter(id=>playerById(id)?.teamId===p.teamId).length;state.onIce[playerId]=setupPositionFor(p.teamId,index,p.id);renderBenches();renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead);$("#topStatus").textContent=`${p.name} placed on the ice.   pushHistory();stopPlayback();state.view="whole";state.onIce=createCanonicalLineup("whole");state.puckStart={x:500,y:300};state.timeline={duration:12,movements:[],puckTakes:[{id:uid("take"),name:"Puck Route A",events:[]}],activeTakeId:null};state.timeline.activeTakeId=state.timeline.puckTakes[0].id;state.drawings=[];const id=uid("option");state.activeVariationId=id;state.variations=[captureVariationFromStateLike(state,id,"Option 1")];ui.playhead=0;ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;ui.reuseRange={start:null,end:null};closeRight({clearSelection:true});setTimelineVisible(false);renderAll();toast("New Version 5.6 board loaded with the canonical 5-on-5 faceoff, goalies, and staff.")

  if(ui.playing)stopPlayback();if(ui.recordingMove?.playerId===playerId){cancelMoveRecording();return}
  const startTime=clamp(Number.isFinite(Number(explicitTime))?Number(explicitTime):mode==="continuation"?continuationTimeForPlayer(playerId,ui.playhead):ui.playhead,0,state.timeline.duration),startPosition=playerPositionAt(playerId,startTime);
  ui.tool="select";updateToolButtons();ui.playhead=startTime;ui.recordingMove={playerId,mode,startTime,startPosition:deepClone(startPosition),points:[],started:false,pointerId:null,startStamp:0};$("#topStatus").textContent=`Trace ${playerById(playerId).name}'s replacement route from ${fmtTime(startTime)}.`;toast("Trace the new skating path on the ice.   pushHistory();const elapsed=Math.max(.35,(performance.now()-rec.startStamp)/1000),maxDuration=Math.max(.35,Math.min(20,60-rec.startTime)),duration=clamp(elapsed,.35,maxDuration);replaceMovementFuture(rec.playerId,rec.startTime);
  const clip={id:uid("mv"),playerId:rec.playerId,start:round(rec.startTime,3),duration:round(duration,3),points:rec.points.map(p=>({x:round(p.x,2),y:round(p.y,2)}))};state.timeline.movements.push(clip);sanitizeMovementTracks(rec.playerId);extendTimelineTo(clip.start+clip.duration);ui.recordingMove=null;$("#previewLayer").innerHTML="";selectItem("clip",clip.id,true);renderAll();toast(`Movement replaced from ${fmtTime(clip.start)}. function addPuckEvent(event,{select=true}={}){pushHistory();event.id=event.id||uid("pe");event.time=clamp(event.time??ui.playhead,0,state.timeline.duration);event.order=event.order||Date.now()+Math.random();activeTake().events.push(event);extendTimelineTo(event.time+2);if(select)selectItem("event",event.id,true);else{renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead);renderInspector()}scheduleSave();return event}
function addPossession(targetId,time=ui.playhead){if(!state.onIce[targetId])return toast("Choose an on-ice player.");return addPuckEvent({type:"possess",targetId,time})}

function newPuckTake({duplicate=false,name=null}={}){pushHistory();const base=activeTake(),take={id:uid("take"),name:name||`Puck Route ${String.fromCharCode(65+state.timeline.puckTakes.length)}`,events:duplicate?deepClone(base.events).map(e=>({...e,id:uid("pe")})):[]};state.timeline.puckTakes.push(take);state.timeline.activeTakeId=take.id;ui.selectedType="puck";ui.selectedId="puck";renderAll();return take}

function handleDirectPlayer(playerId){const ps=puckStateAt(ui.playhead);if(ps.mode==="travel")return toast("The puck is still traveling. function changeView(next){if(next===state.view)return;pushHistory();const old=state.view;state.view=next;const mapPoint=p=>old==="whole"&&next==="half"?{x:clamp(50+p.x*.5,26,574),y:clamp(40+p.y*1.05,26,674)}:{x:clamp((p.x-50)*2,26,974),y:clamp((p.y-40)/1.05,26,574)};for(const id of Object.keys(state.onIce))state.onIce[id]=mapPoint(state.onIce[id]);state.puckStart=mapPoint(state.puckStart);for(const c of state.timeline.movements)c.points=c.points.map(mapPoint);for(const take of state.timeline.puckTakes)for(const e of take.events)if(e.target)e.target=mapPoint(e.target);renderAll();toast(`${next==="half"?"Half":"Whole"} Ice selected.`)}

function onRinkPointerDown(event){const playerNode=event.target.closest?.("[data-player-id]"),puckNode=event.target.closest?.("[data-puck]");if(event.pointerType==="pen"&&(event.button===5||(event.buttons&32))){event.preventDefault();cyclePenTool();return}

}
function onRinkPointerMove(event){if(ui.drawing)return continueDrawing(event);if(ui.erasing?.pointerId===event.pointerId){eraseAt(svgPoint(event));return}if(ui.recordingMove?.started&&ui.recordingMove.pointerId===event.pointerId){const samples=event.getCoalescedEvents?event.getCoalescedEvents():[event];for(const sample of samples){const p=svgPoint(sample),pts=ui.recordingMove.points;if(dist(pts.at(-1),p)>2)pts.push(p)}renderMovePreview();return}if(ui.dragSetup?.pointerId===event.pointerId){const dx=event.clientX-ui.dragSetup.startClient.x,dy=event.clientY-ui.dragSetup.startClient.y;if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)>4)ui.dragSetup.moved=true;state.onIce[ui.dragSetup.playerId]=svgPoint(event);renderFrame(ui.playhead);return}if(ui.dragPuck?.pointerId===event.pointerId){const dx=event.clientX-ui.dragPuck.startClient.x,dy=event.clientY-ui.dragPuck.startClient.y;if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)>4)ui.dragPuck.moved=true;state.puckStart=svgPoint(event);renderFrame(ui.playhead);return}}

function onTimelinePointerUp(){if(!ui.timelineDragging)return;const d=ui.timelineDragging;ui.timelineDragging=null;if(d.kind==="clip"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(c=>c.id===d.id);if(clip)sanitizeMovementTracks(clip.playerId)}renderTimeline();renderInspector();renderFrame(ui.playhead);scheduleSave()}
const COLOR_GRID=["#000000","#FFFFFF","#6B7280","#111827","#EF4444","#F97316","#FEFE00","#84CC16","#00FC05","#10B981","#14B8A6","#39D8FF","#0EA5E9","#2563EB","#4338CA","#8B5CF6","#F100F3","#EC4899","#BE123C","#7C2D12","#92400E","#78350F","#14532D","#164E63"];
function syncColorControls(hex){ui.colorValue=hex.toUpperCase();const rgb=hexToRgb(ui.colorValue);$("#spectrumColor").value=ui.colorValue;for(const [key,val] of [["r",rgb.r],["g",rgb.g],["b",rgb.b]]){$(`#${key}Slider`).value=val;$(`#${key}Number`).value=val}$("#colorPreview").style.background=ui.colorValue}
function openColorDialog(target,current,title,{marker=false}={}){ui.colorTarget=target;$("#colorDialogTitle").textContent=title;$("#markerWidthField").hidden=!marker;$("#colorRoleRow")?.classList.toggle("hidden",target.type==="marker"||target.type==="glow"||target.type==="puckGlow");syncColorControls(current||"#111827");if(marker)$("#markerWidthDialog").value=state.marker.width;$("#colorDialog").showModal()}
function targetCurrentColor(){const target=ui.colorTarget;if(!target)return"#111827";if(target.type==="team"){const team=teamById(target.id);return team[target.slot||"primary"]}if(target.type==="player"){const p=playerById(target.id),colors=playerColors(p);return target.slot==="trim"?colors.trim:colors.primary}if(target.type==="glow"){const p=playerById(target.id);return p.glow.color||playerColors(p).primary}if(target.type==="puckGlow")return state.puckGlow.color||"#39D8FF";return state.marker.color}
function applySelectedColor(){const target=ui.colorTarget;if(!target)return;if(target.type==="team"){pushHistory();teamById(target.id)[target.slot||"primary"]=ui.colorValue}else if(target.type==="player"){pushHistory();const p=playerById(target.id);if((target.slot||"primary")==="primary")p.primaryOverride=ui.colorValue;else p.trimOverride=ui.colorValue}else if(target.type==="glow"){const p=playerById(target.id);p.glow.color=ui.colorValue}else if(target.type==="puckGlow")state.puckGlow.color=ui.colorValue;else{state.marker.color=ui.colorValue;state.marker.width=Number($("#markerWidthDialog").value)||6}$("#colorDialog").close();renderAll()}
function setupColorDialog(){const grid=$("#colorGrid");for(const color of COLOR_GRID){const b=document.createElement("button");b.style.background=color;b.title=color;b.addEventListener("click",()=>syncColorControls(color));grid.append(b)}$$(".color-tab").forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener("click",()=>{$$(".color-tab").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("active",x===btn));$$(".color-panel").forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle("active",p.id===`color-${btn.dataset.colorTab}-panel`))}));$("#spectrumColor").addEventListener("input",e=>syncColorControls(e.target.value));for(const key of ["r","g","b"]){const update=()=>syncColorControls(rgbToHex($("#rNumber").value,$("#gNumber").value,$("#bNumber").value));$(`#${key}Slider`).addEventListener("input",e=>{$(`#${key}Number`).value=e.target.value;update()});$(`#${key}Number`).addEventListener("input",e=>{$(`#${key}Slider`).value=e.target.value;update()})}$("#cancelColorBtn").addEventListener("click",()=>$("#colorDialog").close());$("#applyColorBtn").addEventListener("click",applySelectedColor);$("#markerWidthDialog").addEventListener("input",e=>state.marker.width=Number(e.target.value));$("#colorRoleRow")?.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-color-role]");if(!b||!ui.colorTarget)return;ui.colorTarget.slot=b.dataset.colorRole;syncColorControls(targetCurrentColor());$$("[data-color-role]").forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("primary",x===b))})}
function setupInspectorEvents(){
  const root=$("#inspectorContent");root.addEventListener("pointerdown",event=>{if(event.target.matches('input[type="range"]'))pushHistory()});
  root.addEventListener("pointerover",event=>{const choice=event.target.closest("[data-possession-choice]");if(choice&&ui.possessionTargetId!==choice.dataset.possessionChoice){ui.possessionTargetId=choice.dataset.possessionChoice;root.querySelectorAll(".possession-choice").forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle("active",el===choice));renderFrame(ui.playhead)}});
  root.addEventListener("focusin",event=>{const choice=event.target.closest("[data-possession-choice]");if(choice){ui.possessionTargetId=choice.dataset.possessionChoice;root.querySelectorAll(".possession-choice").forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle("active",el===choice));renderFrame(ui.playhead)}});
  root.addEventListener("click",event=>{
    const choice=event.target.closest("[data-possession-choice]");if(choice){ui.possessionTargetId=choice.dataset.possessionChoice;root.querySelectorAll(".possession-choice").forEach(el=>{el.classList.toggle("active",el===choice);el.setAttribute("aria-selected",el===choice?"true":"false")});renderFrame(ui.playhead);return}
    const clipBtn=event.target.closest("[data-inspect-clip]");if(clipBtn)return selectItem("clip",clipBtn.dataset.inspectClip,true);
    if(event.target.id==="recordMoveBtn"){const p=playerById(ui.selectedId);if(p)startMoveRecording(p.id);return}if(event.target.id==="returnBenchBtn"){returnToBench(ui.selectedId);return}
    if(event.target.id==="playerGlowColor"){const p=playerById(ui.selectedId);if(p)openColorDialog({type:"glow",id:p.id},p.glow.color||playerColors(p).primary,`${t("glowColor")} · ${p.name}`);return}
    if(event.target.id==="puckGlowColor"){openColorDialog({type:"puckGlow"},state.puckGlow.color||"#39D8FF",t("glowColor"));return}
    if(event.target.id==="jumpPlayerStartBtn"){const clips=movementClipsFor(ui.selectedId),clip=[...clips].reverse().find(c=>c.start<ui.playhead-.02);setPlayhead(clip?.start??clips[0]?.start??0);return}if(event.target.id==="jumpPlayerEndBtn"){const clips=movementClipsFor(ui.selectedId),clip=clips.find(c=>c.start>ui.playhead+.02);setPlayhead(clip?.start??clips.at(-1)?.start+clips.at(-1)?.duration??state.timeline.duration);return}
    if(event.target.id==="previewClipBtn"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(clip){setPlayhead(clip.start);if(!ui.playing)togglePlayback()}return}if(event.target.id==="selectClipPlayerBtn"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(clip)selectItem("player",clip.playerId,true);return}
    if(event.target.id==="deleteClipBtn"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(c=>c.id===ui.selectedId),playerId=clip?.playerId;pushHistory();state.timeline.movements=state.timeline.movements.filter(c=>c.id!==ui.selectedId);if(playerId)selectItem("player",playerId,true);else closeRight({clearSelection:true});renderAll();return}
    if(event.target.id==="liveDirectBtn"){if(ui.directPuck)stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});else startLiveDirect({newTake:false});return}if(event.target.id==="newLiveTakeBtn"){startLiveDirect({newTake:true,fromStart:true});return}if(event.target.id==="duplicateTakeBtn"){newPuckTake({duplicate:true});return}if(event.target.id==="deleteTakeBtn"){deleteActiveTake();return}
    if(event.target.id==="addPossessionBtn"){if(ui.possessionTargetId)addPossession(ui.possessionTargetId,ui.playhead);return}if(event.target.id==="passTargetBtn"){ui.targetMode={type:"pass"};return toast(t("passTap"))}if(event.target.id==="shotTargetBtn"){ui.targetMode={type:"shot"};return toast(t("shootTap"))}if(event.target.id==="dropPuckBtn"){addDrop(ui.playhead);return}if(event.target.id==="clearPuckTakeBtn"){clearActiveTake();return}
    if(event.target.id==="previewEventBtn"){const ev=activeTake().events.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(ev)setPlayhead(ev.time);return}if(event.target.id==="retargetShotBtn"){ui.targetMode={type:"retarget",eventId:ui.selectedId};return toast(t("retargetShot"))}if(event.target.id==="deleteEventBtn"){pushHistory();activeTake().events=activeTake().events.filter(x=>x.id!==ui.selectedId);ui.selectedType="puck";ui.selectedId="puck";renderAll();return}
  });
  root.addEventListener("input",event=>{const id=event.target.id;
    if(id==="clipStartRange"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(clip){clip.start=Number(event.target.value);$("#clipStartOut").textContent=fmtTime(clip.start);renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}
    else if(id==="clipDurationRange"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(clip){clip.duration=Number(event.target.value);extendTimelineTo(clip.start+clip.duration);$("#clipDurationOut").textContent=`${clip.duration.toFixed(2)} s`;renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}
    else if(id==="playerGlowCheck"){const p=playerById(ui.selectedId);if(p){p.glow.enabled=event.target.checked;if(!p.glow.color)p.glow.color=playerColors(p).primary;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}else if(id==="playerGlowBlink"){const p=playerById(ui.selectedId);if(p){p.glow.blink=event.target.checked;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}else if(id==="playerGlowBrightness"){const p=playerById(ui.selectedId);if(p){p.glow.brightness=Number(event.target.value);$("#playerGlowBrightnessOut").textContent=`${event.target.value}%`;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}else if(id==="playerGlowRate"){const p=playerById(ui.selectedId);if(p){p.glow.rate=Number(event.target.value);$("#playerGlowRateOut").textContent=`${Number(event.target.value).toFixed(2)} Hz`;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}
    else if(id==="puckGlowCheck"){state.puckGlow.enabled=event.target.checked;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}else if(id==="puckGlowBlink"){state.puckGlow.blink=event.target.checked;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}else if(id==="puckGlowBrightness"){state.puckGlow.brightness=Number(event.target.value);$("#puckGlowBrightnessOut").textContent=`${event.target.value}%`;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}else if(id==="puckGlowRate"){state.puckGlow.rate=Number(event.target.value);$("#puckGlowRateOut").textContent=`${Number(event.target.value).toFixed(2)} Hz`;renderFrame(ui.playhead)}
    else if(id==="passSpeedDefault"){ui.puckOptions.passSpeed=Number(event.target.value);$("#passSpeedOut").textContent=`${event.target.value}/10`}else if(id==="sauceDefault")ui.puckOptions.sauce=event.target.checked;else if(id==="passIgnoreDefault")ui.puckOptions.passIgnore=event.target.checked;else if(id==="shotPowerDefault"){ui.puckOptions.shotPower=Number(event.target.value);$("#shotPowerOut").textContent=`${event.target.value}/10`}else if(id==="shotIgnoreDefault")ui.puckOptions.shotIgnore=event.target.checked;
    else if(id==="eventTimeRange"){const ev=activeTake().events.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(ev){ev.time=Number(event.target.value);ui.playhead=ev.time;$("#eventTimeOut").textContent=fmtTime(ev.time);renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}else if(id==="eventSpeedRange"){const ev=activeTake().events.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(ev){ev.speed=Number(event.target.value);$("#eventSpeedOut").textContent=`${ev.speed}/10`;renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}else if(id==="eventPowerRange"){const ev=activeTake().events.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(ev){ev.power=Number(event.target.value);$("#eventPowerOut").textContent=`${ev.power}/10`;renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}else if(id==="eventSauce"){const ev=activeTake().events.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(ev){ev.sauce=event.target.checked;renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}else if(id==="eventIgnore"){const ev=activeTake().events.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(ev){ev.ignoreDefense=event.target.checked;renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead)}}scheduleSave()
  });
  root.addEventListener("change",event=>{if(event.target.id==="puckTakeSelect"){state.timeline.activeTakeId=event.target.value;ui.playhead=0;renderAll()}else if(event.target.id==="eventTargetSelect"){pushHistory();const ev=activeTake().events.find(x=>x.id===ui.selectedId);if(ev){ev.targetId=event.target.value;ui.possessionTargetId=ev.targetId;renderAll()}}})
}
function contentEnd(){let m=0;for(const c of state.timeline.movements)m=Math.max(m,c.start+c.duration);for(const e of activeTake().events){m=Math.max(m,e.time);const r=eventResult(e.id);if(r?.arrival)m=Math.max(m,r.arrival)}return m}
function setTimelineDuration(value){const min=Math.max(4,Math.ceil(contentEnd()+.2));state.timeline.duration=clamp(Math.max(Number(value)||12,min),4,60);ui.playhead=clamp(ui.playhead,0,state.timeline.duration);renderSettings();renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead);scheduleSave()}
function toggleLeft(open){const drawer=$("#leftDrawer");if(open===undefined)open=document.body.classList.contains("left-hidden");document.body.classList.toggle("left-hidden",!open);drawer.classList.toggle("open",open);updateDrawerHandles();requestAnimationFrame(fitRink)}
async function toggleFullscreen(){try{if(!document.fullscreenElement){await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.();document.body.classList.add("focus-mode")}else{await document.exitFullscreen?.();document.body.classList.remove("focus-mode")}}catch{document.body.classList.toggle("focus-mode")}}
function saveCurrentPlay(){const name=prompt("Name this Version 6.8 timeline play:",`Play ${userPlays.length+1}`);if(!name)return;userPlays.push(snapshotPlay(name));renderPlaybook();saveSession();toast(`Saved “${name}” to ${state.playbookName}.`)}
function loadUserPlay(index){const play=userPlays[index];if(!play)return;loadPlay(play);state.drawings=deepClone(play.drawings||[]);renderAll()}
function exportPlaybook(){syncActiveVariation();const payload={format:"BOTD-HOCKEY-PLAYBOOK-V5",version:APP_VERSION,name:state.playbookName,logo:state.playbookLogo,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),plays:userPlays};download(`${(state.playbookName||"BOTD_Playbook").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi,"_")}_v6_8.json`,JSON.stringify(payload,null,2),"application/json")}
async function importPlaybookFile(file){try{const data=JSON.parse(await file.text());if(data.format!=="BOTD-HOCKEY-PLAYBOOK-V5"||!Array.isArray(data.plays))throw new Error("This is not a Version 5 playbook file.");state.playbookName=data.name||state.playbookName;state.playbookLogo=data.logo||state.playbookLogo;userPlays=data.plays;renderAll();saveSession();toast(`Imported ${userPlays.length} Version 5 play${userPlays.length===1?"":"s"}.`)}catch(e){toast(e.message||"Could not import playbook.",4200)}}

function decorateInspectorV53(){

  if(!root)return;

    const p=playerById(ui.selectedId);
    if(!p)return;
    const current=movementActionAt(p.id,ui.playhead);
    const meta=actionMeta(current.type);
    const section=$("#recordMoveBtn",root)?.closest(".inspector-section");
    if(section&&!section.querySelector(".action-now-card")){
      section.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin",`<div class="action-now-card"><span class="action-now-icon">${meta.glyph}</span><span><strong>${escapeHtml(meta.label)} at ${fmtTime(ui.playhead)}</strong><small>Pause anywhere, then revise this player's route and skating action from the exact frame.</small></span></div>`);
    }
    const record=$("#recordMoveBtn",root);
    if(record){
      record.textContent=ui.recordingMove?.playerId===p.id?"Cancel Action Recording":`Move from ${fmtTime(ui.playhead)}`;
      record.title="Split at the exact playhead frame and revise this player's action.";
    }
    const here=$("#recordMoveHereBtn",root);
    if(here){
      here.textContent="Add Next Action After Current";
      here.title="Begin a new action at the current clip endpoint.";
    }
    const help=section?.querySelector(".replace-help");
    if(help)help.textContent="Choose Forward, Backward, Crossover, Glide, or Hold. Earlier movement remains exact; Move replaces this player's future route only.";
    for(const btn of $$('[data-inspect-clip]',root)){
      const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(c=>c.id===btn.dataset.inspectClip);
      if(clip)btn.textContent=`${actionMeta(clip.actionType).label} · ${fmtTime(clip.start)}–${fmtTime(clip.start+clip.duration)}`;
    }
  }

  if(ui.selectedType==="clip"){
    const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(c=>c.id===ui.selectedId);
    if(!clip)return;
    const first=root.querySelector(".inspector-section");
    if(first&&!root.querySelector(".clip-action-editor")){
      const options=Object.entries(ACTION_TYPES).map(([key,m])=>`<option value="${key}" ${normalizeActionType(clip.actionType)===key?"selected":""}>${m.label}</option>`).join("");
      first.insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin",`<section class="inspector-section clip-action-editor"><h3>Skating Action</h3><select id="clipActionTypeSelect">${options}</select><p class="action-revision-note">This label controls route notation.     }
    const fromPlay=$("#recordFromClipPlayheadBtn",root);
    const fromEnd=$("#recordFromClipEndBtn",root);
    if(fromPlay)fromPlay.textContent="Move From Playhead";
    if(fromEnd)fromEnd.textContent="Add After Clip";
    const help=root.querySelector(".replace-help");
    if(help)help.textContent="A revision splits the selected player's path at the exact frame. No movement clips are stacked or overlapped.";
  }

/* Version 5.4 direct-route refinement retained beneath the Version 5.5 route editor. */
function benchCategoryFor(player){return player.role==="goalie"?"goalies":(player.role==="coach"||player.role==="manager")?"staff":"players"}
function categoryBenchSort(a,b){const cat=benchCategoryFor(a),catB=benchCategoryFor(b);if(cat!==catB)return cat.localeCompare(catB);return a.teamId.localeCompare(b.teamId)||rosterSort(a,b)}
renderBenches=function(){
  const categories=[
    {id:"players",root:$("#benchPlayers"),title:"Players",filter:p=>p.role==="skater"},
    {id:"goalies",root:$("#benchGoalies"),title:"Goalies",filter:p=>p.role==="goalie"},
    {id:"staff",root:$("#benchStaff"),title:"Staff",filter:p=>p.role==="coach"||p.role==="manager"}
  ];
  for(const category of categories){
    const root=category.root;if(!root)continue;
    const bench=allRoster().filter(p=>category.filter(p)&&!state.onIce[p.id]).sort(categoryBenchSort);
    root.innerHTML=`<div class="bench-label"><strong>${escapeHtml(category.title)}</strong><span>${bench.length} available</span></div>`;
    for(const p of bench){
      const c=playerColors(p),team=teamById(p.teamId),tok=document.createElement("button"),roleClass=p.role==="goalie"?"goalie":p.role==="coach"||p.role==="manager"?"staff":"skater";
      const lineText=p.role==="skater"?(p.position==="LD"||p.position==="RD"?`D Pair ${p.line} · ${p.position}`:`F Line ${p.line} · ${p.position}`):p.role==="goalie"?"Goalie":p.role==="coach"?"Head Coach":"Manager";
      const badge=p.role==="coach"?"HC":p.role==="manager"?"MGR":p.role==="goalie"?(p.number||"G"):(p.number||p.position);
      tok.className=`bench-token bench-card ${roleClass}`;tok.dataset.benchPlayer=p.id;tok.title=t("placeOnIce",{name:p.name});tok.style.setProperty("--piece-primary",c.primary);tok.style.setProperty("--piece-trim",c.trim);tok.style.setProperty("--piece-ink",contrastText(c.primary));
      tok.innerHTML=`<span class="bench-piece"><span>${escapeHtml(badge)}</span></span><span class="bench-card-copy"><strong>${escapeHtml(p.name||"Blank token")}</strong><small><span class="team-line">${escapeHtml(team?.name||p.teamId)}</span>${p.number?` · #${escapeHtml(p.number)}`:""} · ${escapeHtml(p.position)}${p.hand&&p.role==="skater"?` · ${escapeHtml(p.hand)}`:""}</small><em>${escapeHtml(lineText)}</em></span>`;
      root.appendChild(tok);
    }
  }
};
addToIce=function(playerId){

  pushHistory();
  const roleGroup=p.role==="skater"?"skater":p.role==="goalie"?"goalie":p.role;
  const index=Object.keys(state.onIce).filter(id=>{const x=playerById(id);const g=x?.role==="skater"?"skater":x?.role==="goalie"?"goalie":x?.role;return x?.teamId===p.teamId&&g===roleGroup}).length;
  state.onIce[playerId]=setupPositionFor(p.teamId,index,p.id);
  renderBenches();renderTimeline();renderFrame(ui.playhead);
  $("#topStatus").textContent=`${p.name} placed on the ice. Select the rink token and tap Move to redraw that player's route from any playhead frame.`;
  scheduleSave();toast(`${p.name} added to the ice.`,1500);
};

  ui.playhead=0;ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;ui.reuseRange={start:null,end:null};ui.actionDraft=null;
  closeRight({clearSelection:true});setTimelineVisible(false);renderAll();toast("New clean sheet loaded. Every player, goalie, and staff member is on the two team benches.",3600);
};
function startDirectPlayerMove(playerId,mode="playhead",explicitTime=null){

  const startTime=round(clamp(Number.isFinite(Number(explicitTime))?Number(explicitTime):mode==="continuation"?continuationTimeForPlayer(playerId,ui.playhead):ui.playhead,0,state.timeline.duration),3);

/* Version 5.5 — ordered team benches and exact selected-player route replacement (retained in 5.6). */
function teamBenchGoalieIndex(player){
  const goalies=(state.rosters[player.teamId]||[]).filter(item=>item.role==="goalie");
  return Math.max(0,goalies.findIndex(item=>item.id===player.id));
}
function teamBenchOrderKey(player){
  const roster=state.rosters[player.teamId]||[],rosterIndex=Math.max(0,roster.findIndex(item=>item.id===player.id));
  if(player.role==="goalie"){
    const goalieIndex=teamBenchGoalieIndex(player);
    return goalieIndex===0?[0,0,rosterIndex]:[900,goalieIndex,rosterIndex];
  }
  if(player.role==="skater"){
    const line=Math.max(1,Number(player.line)||99),isDefense=player.position==="LD"||player.position==="RD";
    const positionOrder=isDefense?({LD:0,RD:1}[player.position]??9):({LW:0,C:1,RW:2}[player.position]??9);
    return[line*10+(isDefense?2:1),positionOrder,rosterIndex];
  }
  if(player.role==="coach")return[1000,0,rosterIndex];
  if(player.role==="manager")return[1000,1,rosterIndex];
  return[1100,0,rosterIndex];
}
function teamBenchSort(a,b){
  const ak=teamBenchOrderKey(a),bk=teamBenchOrderKey(b);
  for(let i=0;i<Math.max(ak.length,bk.length);i++){const delta=(ak[i]??0)-(bk[i]??0);if(delta)return delta}
  return String(a.name||"").localeCompare(String(b.name||""));
}
function teamBenchRoleLabel(player){
  if(player.role==="goalie")return teamBenchGoalieIndex(player)===0?"Starting Goalie":"Backup Goalie";
  if(player.role==="coach")return"Head Coach";
  if(player.role==="manager")return"Manager";
  if(player.position==="LD"||player.position==="RD")return`D Pair ${player.line} · ${player.position}`;
  return`F Line ${player.line} · ${player.position}`;
}
function updateBenchDrawer(){
  const hidden=document.body.classList.contains("benches-hidden"),button=$("#benchDrawerToggle"),stateLabel=button?.querySelector(".bench-drawer-state"),chevron=button?.querySelector(".bench-drawer-chevron");
  if(button){button.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(!hidden));button.title=hidden?"Show team benches":"Hide team benches"}
  if(stateLabel)stateLabel.textContent=hidden?"Show":"Hide";
  if(chevron)chevron.textContent=hidden?"⌄":"⌃";
}
function setBenchesVisible(visible){
  document.body.classList.toggle("benches-hidden",!visible);updateBenchDrawer();requestAnimationFrame(fitRink);
}
renderBenches=function(){
  const summary=[];
  for(const teamId of ["A","B"]){
    const root=$(teamId==="A"?"#benchA":"#benchB"),team=teamById(teamId);if(!root||!team)continue;
    const bench=(state.rosters[teamId]||[]).filter(player=>!state.onIce[player.id]).sort(teamBenchSort);summary.push(`${team.name}: ${bench.length}`);
    root.innerHTML=`<div class="bench-label"><strong>${escapeHtml(team.name)}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(t("onBench",{count:bench.length}))}</span></div>`;
    for(const player of bench){
      const colors=playerColors(player),token=document.createElement("button"),roleClass=player.role==="goalie"?"goalie":player.role==="coach"||player.role==="manager"?"staff":"skater";
      const badge=player.role==="coach"?"HC":player.role==="manager"?"MGR":player.role==="goalie"?(player.number||"G"):(player.number||player.position);
      token.className=`bench-token bench-card ${roleClass}`;token.dataset.benchPlayer=player.id;token.title=t("placeOnIce",{name:player.name});token.style.setProperty("--piece-primary",colors.primary);token.style.setProperty("--piece-trim",colors.trim);token.style.setProperty("--piece-ink",contrastText(colors.primary));
      token.innerHTML=`<span class="bench-piece"><span>${escapeHtml(badge)}</span></span><span class="bench-card-copy"><strong>${escapeHtml(player.name||"Blank token")}</strong><small>${player.number?`#${escapeHtml(player.number)} · `:""}${escapeHtml(player.position)}${player.hand&&player.role==="skater"?` · ${escapeHtml(player.hand)}`:""}</small><em>${escapeHtml(teamBenchRoleLabel(player))}</em></span>`;
      root.appendChild(token);
    }

  const summaryNode=$("#benchDrawerSummary");if(summaryNode)summaryNode.textContent=summary.join("  ·  ");updateBenchDrawer();

/* Remove skating-action notation while preserving old play-file compatibility. */
renderRoutes=function(time){
  const layer=$("#routeLayer");layer.innerHTML="";if(!state.display.routes||state.display.routeMode==="off")return;
  for(const clip of state.timeline.movements){
    let points=clip.points;
    if(state.display.routeMode==="ahead"&&time>=clip.start&&time<=clip.start+clip.duration){const progress=(time-clip.start)/Math.max(.001,clip.duration),idx=Math.max(0,Math.floor(progress*(points.length-1)));points=[pointAtPolyline(points,progress),...points.slice(idx+1)]}
    else if(state.display.routeMode==="ahead"&&time>clip.start+clip.duration)continue;
    const player=playerById(clip.playerId),color=player?playerColors(player).primary:"#39d8ff";layer.append(svgEl("path",{d:pathD(points),class:"route-path",stroke:color}));
  }
  const puckTimeline=buildPuckTimeline();for(const interval of puckTimeline.intervals){if(interval.kind!=="travel")continue;if(state.display.routeMode==="ahead"&&time>interval.end)continue;let points=interval.path;if(state.display.routeMode==="ahead"&&time>=interval.start&&time<=interval.end){const progress=(time-interval.start)/Math.max(.001,interval.end-interval.start),idx=Math.floor(progress*(points.length-1));points=[pointAtPolyline(points,progress),...points.slice(idx+1)]}layer.append(svgEl("path",{d:pathD(points),class:"route-path",stroke:"#14181c","stroke-dasharray":interval.sauce?"10 7":""}))}
};

function normalizeMoveRoute(points,anchor){
  const route=(Array.isArray(points)?points:[]).filter(point=>Number.isFinite(Number(point?.x))&&Number.isFinite(Number(point?.y))).map(point=>clampRinkPoint({x:Number(point.x),y:Number(point.y)}));
  if(!route.length)route.push(deepClone(anchor));if(dist(route[0],anchor)>.01)route.unshift(deepClone(anchor));else route[0]=deepClone(anchor);if(route.length===1)route.push(deepClone(anchor));return route;
}
function commitMoveFromPlayhead({playerId,startTime,startPosition,points,duration,history=true,select=true,render=true}={}){
  const player=playerById(playerId);if(!player||!state.onIce[playerId])return null;
  const start=round(clamp(Number(startTime)||0,0,59.95),3),anchor=clampRinkPoint(startPosition&&Number.isFinite(Number(startPosition.x))?{x:Number(startPosition.x),y:Number(startPosition.y)}:playerPositionAt(playerId,start));
  const route=normalizeMoveRoute(points,anchor),moveDuration=round(clamp(Number(duration)||1,.05,Math.max(.05,60-start)),3),kept=[];
  if(history)pushHistory();
  for(const raw of state.timeline.movements){
    if(raw.playerId!==playerId){kept.push(raw);continue}
    const clipEnd=round(raw.start+raw.duration,3);
    if(clipEnd<=start+.001){kept.push(raw);continue}
    if(raw.start<start-.001){const prefix=trimMovementClip(raw,raw.start,start);if(prefix.duration>=.05){prefix.points[prefix.points.length-1]=deepClone(anchor);kept.push(prefix)}}
  }
  const clip={id:uid("mv"),playerId,start,duration:moveDuration,points:route.map(point=>({x:round(point.x,2),y:round(point.y,2)})),revision:{time:start,scope:"selected-player-future",createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}};
  state.timeline.movements=[...kept,clip];sanitizeMovementTracks(playerId);extendTimelineTo(start+moveDuration);ui.playhead=start;if(select){ui.selectedType="clip";ui.selectedId=clip.id}if(render)renderAll();return state.timeline.movements.find(item=>item.id===clip.id)||clip;
}
startDirectPlayerMove=function(playerId,mode="playhead",explicitTime=null){
  const player=playerById(playerId);if(!player||!state.onIce[playerId])return toast("Select an on-ice player first.");
  if(ui.playing)stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});if(ui.recordingMove)cancelMoveRecording();

    }

/* Version 5.8 — orientation-safe ice switching and practical Rule 83 indicator. */
const V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS=Object.freeze({minX:26,maxX:974,minY:26,maxY:574});
const V58_HALF_BOUNDS=Object.freeze({minX:26,maxX:574,minY:26,maxY:674});
function v58FinitePoint(point){return !!(point&&Number.isFinite(Number(point.x))&&Number.isFinite(Number(point.y)))}
function v58TransformPoint(point,fromView,toView){
  if(!v58FinitePoint(point)||fromView===toView)return v58FinitePoint(point)?{x:Number(point.x),y:Number(point.y)}:point;
  const p={x:Number(point.x),y:Number(point.y)};
  if(fromView==="whole"&&toView==="half"){
    const across=clamp((p.x-V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minX)/(V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.maxX-V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minX),0,1);
    const lateral=clamp((p.y-V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minY)/(V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.maxY-V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minY),0,1);
    return{x:round(V58_HALF_BOUNDS.minX+lateral*(V58_HALF_BOUNDS.maxX-V58_HALF_BOUNDS.minX),4),y:round(V58_HALF_BOUNDS.maxY-across*(V58_HALF_BOUNDS.maxY-V58_HALF_BOUNDS.minY),4)}
  }
  if(fromView==="half"&&toView==="whole"){
    const across=clamp((V58_HALF_BOUNDS.maxY-p.y)/(V58_HALF_BOUNDS.maxY-V58_HALF_BOUNDS.minY),0,1);
    const lateral=clamp((p.x-V58_HALF_BOUNDS.minX)/(V58_HALF_BOUNDS.maxX-V58_HALF_BOUNDS.minX),0,1);
    return{x:round(V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minX+across*(V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.maxX-V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minX),4),y:round(V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minY+lateral*(V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.maxY-V58_WHOLE_BOUNDS.minY),4)}
  }
  return{x:p.x,y:p.y}
}
function v58TransformPointField(owner,key,fromView,toView){if(owner&&v58FinitePoint(owner[key]))owner[key]=v58TransformPoint(owner[key],fromView,toView)}
function v58TransformVariationGeometry(option,fromView,toView){
  if(!option||option.view!==fromView)return option;
  for(const id of Object.keys(option.onIce||{}))if(v58FinitePoint(option.onIce[id]))option.onIce[id]=v58TransformPoint(option.onIce[id],fromView,toView);
  if(v58FinitePoint(option.puckStart))option.puckStart=v58TransformPoint(option.puckStart,fromView,toView);
  for(const clip of option.timeline?.movements||[])clip.points=(clip.points||[]).map(point=>v58TransformPoint(point,fromView,toView));
  for(const take of option.timeline?.puckTakes||[])for(const event of take.events||[]){
    for(const key of ["target","from","position","point","targetPoint","startPosition","endPosition","anchor"])v58TransformPointField(event,key,fromView,toView);
    for(const key of ["path","points","reboundPath"])if(Array.isArray(event[key]))event[key]=event[key].map(point=>v58FinitePoint(point)?v58TransformPoint(point,fromView,toView):point)
  }
  for(const stroke of option.drawings||[])stroke.points=(stroke.points||[]).map(point=>v58TransformPoint(point,fromView,toView));
  option.view=toView;return option
}
changeView=function(next){
  next=next==="half"?"half":"whole";if(next===state.view)return;
  if(ui.recordingMove)cancelMoveRecording();stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});
  ui.directPuck=false;ui.targetMode=null;ui.possessionTargetId=null;ui.dragPuck=null;ui.dragSetup=null;ui.drawing=null;ui.erasing=false;
  pushHistory();syncActiveVariation();
  const previous=state.view;
  if(Array.isArray(state.variations)&&state.variations.length){
    for(const option of state.variations)v58TransformVariationGeometry(option,previous,next);
    const active=state.variations.find(option=>option.id===state.activeVariationId)||state.variations[0];applyVariation(active)
  }else{
    const temporary=captureVariationFromStateLike(state,uid("option"),"Option 1");v58TransformVariationGeometry(temporary,previous,next);state.activeVariationId=temporary.id;state.variations=[temporary];applyVariation(temporary)
  }
  state.view=next;ui.lastValidPuckPos=null;ui.liveGoalEvent=null;drawUndo=[];drawRedo=[];renderAll();
  toast(next==="half"?"Half Ice selected. Player paths, puck targets, and telestration now run bottom-to-top.":"Full Ice selected. Every route and object returned to its left-to-right orientation.",4600)
};

function v58OffsideModel(teamId){
  if(state.view==="half")return{axis:"y",direction:-1,edge:430-5.5};
  return teamId==="A"?{axis:"x",direction:1,edge:670+5.5}:{axis:"x",direction:-1,edge:330-5.5}
}
function v58CompletelyAcross(point,model,halfExtent){
  if(!v58FinitePoint(point))return false;const value=Number(point[model.axis]);
  return model.direction>0?value-halfExtent>model.edge+.001:value+halfExtent<model.edge-.001
}
function v58PlayerFullyAcross(playerId,time,model){return v58CompletelyAcross(playerPositionAt(playerId,time),model,9)}
function v58PuckFullyAcross(position,model){return v58CompletelyAcross(position,model,model.axis==="x"?13:6)}
offsideStateAt=function(time,puckTimeline=buildPuckTimeline()){
  if(!state.display.offside)return"hidden";
  const end=clamp(Number(time)||0,0,state.timeline.duration),pending=new Set();let attackTeam=null,lastPuckIn=false,initialized=false,violation=false,controlledHolder=null,holderControlledBeforeEntry=false;
  const evaluate=sampleTime=>{
    const puckState=puckStateAt(sampleTime,puckTimeline),holderPlayer=puckState.mode==="attached"&&puckState.holder?playerById(puckState.holder):null,nextTeam=holderPlayer?.teamId||attackTeam;
    if(!nextTeam)return;
    if(nextTeam!==attackTeam){attackTeam=nextTeam;pending.clear();lastPuckIn=false;initialized=false;violation=false;controlledHolder=null;holderControlledBeforeEntry=false}
    const model=v58OffsideModel(attackTeam);
    if(puckState.mode==="attached"&&puckState.holder){
      if(controlledHolder!==puckState.holder){controlledHolder=puckState.holder;holderControlledBeforeEntry=!v58PlayerFullyAcross(controlledHolder,sampleTime,model)}
    }else{controlledHolder=null;holderControlledBeforeEntry=false}
    const puckIn=v58PuckFullyAcross(puckState.pos,model),earlyNow=new Set();
    for(const id of Object.keys(state.onIce)){
      const player=playerById(id);if(!player||player.teamId!==attackTeam||player.role!=="skater")continue;
      const fullyAcross=v58PlayerFullyAcross(id,sampleTime,model),controlledCarrierException=fullyAcross&&puckState.mode==="attached"&&puckState.holder===id&&holderControlledBeforeEntry;
      if(fullyAcross&&!controlledCarrierException)earlyNow.add(id)
    }
    if(!initialized){initialized=true;lastPuckIn=puckIn;if(!puckIn)for(const id of earlyNow)pending.add(id);return}
    for(const id of [...pending])if(!earlyNow.has(id))pending.delete(id);
    if(!puckIn){for(const id of earlyNow)pending.add(id);violation=false}
    else{if(!lastPuckIn&&pending.size)violation=true;if(!pending.size)violation=false}
    lastPuckIn=puckIn
  };
  const step=Math.min(.05,Math.max(.016,end/1200||.016));for(let sample=0;sample<end-.0001;sample+=step)evaluate(sample);evaluate(end);
  return violation?"red":pending.size?"orange":"green"
};

const renderObjectLayerV57ForV58=renderObjectLayer;
renderObjectLayer=function(time){
  renderObjectLayerV57ForV58(time);if(state.view!=="half")return;const layer=$("#objectLayer");if(!layer)return;
  for(const group of layer.querySelectorAll("[data-player-id]")){

/* Version 6.0 — camera-based Half Ice. The play always remains in canonical Full Ice coordinates. */
const V59_COORDINATE_SPACE="whole-ice-v59";

function v59ValidPoint(point){return !!(point&&Number.isFinite(Number(point.x))&&Number.isFinite(Number(point.y)))}

function v59WholeToHalfView(point,side=state?.halfSide||"right"){

function v59HalfViewToWhole(point,side=state?.halfSide||"right"){

  if(v59ValidPoint(container.puckStart))container.puckStart=mapPoint(container.puckStart);
  const timeline=container.timeline||container;
  for(const clip of timeline.movements||container.movements||[])clip.points=(clip.points||[]).map(point=>v59ValidPoint(point)?mapPoint(point):point);
  const takes=timeline.puckTakes||container.puckTakes||[];
  for(const take of takes)for(const event of take.events||[]){
    for(const key of ["target","from","position","point","targetPoint","startPosition","endPosition","anchor"])v59MapPointField(event,key,mapPoint);
    for(const key of ["path","points","reboundPath"])if(Array.isArray(event[key]))event[key]=event[key].map(point=>v59ValidPoint(point)?mapPoint(point):point)

const snapshotPlayV58ForV59=snapshotPlay;

function v59MigrateSavedPlays(){userPlays=(Array.isArray(userPlays)?userPlays:[]).map(play=>v59NormalizePlayData(play,{nativeHalfSide:play?.halfSide||"right"}))}

const loadPlayV58ForV59=loadPlay;

const newBoardV58ForV59=newBoard;
newBoard=function(){newBoardV58ForV59();state.halfSide="right";state.coordinateSpace=V59_COORDINATE_SPACE;state.version=APP_VERSION;syncActiveVariation();renderAll()};

createCanonicalLineup=function(){return deepClone(DEFAULT_WHOLE_LINEUP)};
setupPositionFor=function(teamId,index=0,playerId=null){
  const p=playerId?playerById(playerId):null;if(playerId&&DEFAULT_WHOLE_LINEUP[playerId])return deepClone(DEFAULT_WHOLE_LINEUP[playerId]);
  if(p?.role==="goalie")return teamId==="A"?{x:62,y:300+index*34}:{x:938,y:300+index*34};
  if(p?.role==="coach"||p?.role==="manager")return teamId==="A"?{x:p.role==="coach"?455:390,y:64}:{x:p.role==="coach"?545:610,y:64};
  const slots=teamId==="A"?[{x:465,y:300},{x:465,y:210},{x:465,y:390},{x:380,y:235},{x:380,y:365}]:[{x:535,y:300},{x:535,y:390},{x:535,y:210},{x:620,y:235},{x:620,y:365}];
  return slots[index]||(teamId==="A"?{x:250+(index%4)*55,y:120+Math.floor(index/4)*55}:{x:750-(index%4)*55,y:120+Math.floor(index/4)*55})
};
rinkBounds=function(){return{...V59_WORLD_BOUNDS}};
function v59VisibleWorldBounds(){return state.view!=="half"?V59_WORLD_BOUNDS:state.halfSide==="left"?{...V59_WORLD_BOUNDS,maxX:500}:{...V59_WORLD_BOUNDS,minX:500}}

attackVector=function(teamId){return teamId==="A"?{x:1,y:0}:{x:-1,y:0}};
goalResultForShot=function(start,target){
  if(start.x<=925&&target.x>925){const u=(925-start.x)/(target.x-start.x||1),y=lerp(start.y,target.y,u);if(y>=257&&y<=343)return{goal:true,entry:{x:925,y},end:{x:950,y:clamp(target.y,266,334)},side:"right"}}
  if(start.x>=75&&target.x<75){const u=(75-start.x)/(target.x-start.x||1),y=lerp(start.y,target.y,u);if(y>=257&&y<=343)return{goal:true,entry:{x:75,y},end:{x:50,y:clamp(target.y,266,334)},side:"left"}}

v58OffsideModel=function(teamId){return teamId==="A"?{axis:"x",direction:1,edge:670+5.5}:{axis:"x",direction:-1,edge:330-5.5}};

function v59EnsureWorldCamera(){
  let camera=$("#worldCameraV59");if(camera)return camera;const svg=$("#rinkSvg"),full=$("#fullRink");if(!svg||!full)return null;
  camera=svgEl("g",{id:"worldCameraV59","data-coordinate-space":V59_COORDINATE_SPACE});svg.insertBefore(camera,full);camera.append(full);
  for(const id of ["drawingLayer","routeLayer","previewLayer","objectLayer","puckLayer","targetLayer"]){const node=$("#"+id);if(node)camera.append(node)}

  else if(ui.selectedType==="player"&&state.onIce[ui.selectedId])point=playerPositionAt(ui.selectedId,ui.playhead);
  else if(ui.selectedType==="puck"||ui.selectedType==="event")point=puckStateAt(ui.playhead).pos;
  if(!point)point=puckStateAt(ui.playhead).pos;if(v59ValidPoint(point)&&Math.abs(point.x-500)>4)return point.x<500?"left":"right";

  if(pill){pill.hidden=!half;pill.dataset.side=side;pill.setAttribute("aria-label",`Half Ice end: ${side==="left"?"Left":"Right"}`);pill.setAttribute("title",`Showing the ${side} end. Tap LEFT or RIGHT to change ends.`)}
  if(badge){badge.textContent=half?`${t("halfBadge")} - ${side==="left"?"LEFT END":"RIGHT END"}`:t("wholeBadge");const destination=half?"Full Ice":"Half Ice - Right End";badge.setAttribute("aria-label",`Switch to ${destination}`);badge.setAttribute("title",`Switch to ${destination}`);badge.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(half))}
}
fitRink=function(){
  cancelAnimationFrame(rinkFitRaf);rinkFitRaf=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const shell=$(".rink-shell"),frame=$("#rinkFrame");if(!shell||!frame)return;const sw=Math.max(0,shell.clientWidth-2),sh=Math.max(0,shell.clientHeight-2);if(sw<40||sh<40)return;const ratio=state.view==="half"?V59_HALF_VIEWBOX.width/V59_HALF_VIEWBOX.height:1000/600;let width=sw,height=width/ratio;if(height>sh){height=sh;width=height*ratio}frame.style.width=`${Math.floor(width)}px`;frame.style.height=`${Math.floor(height)}px`})
};

  const camera=v59EnsureWorldCamera(),half=state.view==="half",side=state.halfSide==="left"?"left":"right",svg=$("#rinkSvg"),frame=$("#rinkFrame");
  frame.classList.toggle("half",half);frame.classList.toggle("whole",!half);svg.setAttribute("viewBox",half?`0 0 ${V59_HALF_VIEWBOX.width} ${V59_HALF_VIEWBOX.height}`:"0 0 1000 600");
  if(camera)camera.setAttribute("transform",half?v59CameraMatrix(side):"matrix(1 0 0 1 0 0)");$("#fullRink").style.display="inline";$("#halfRink").style.display="none";
  $("#centerLogoFull").setAttribute("href",state.centerLogo||CENTER_LOGO_DEFAULT);$("#centerLogoFull").setAttribute("opacity",state.logoOpacity);v59RenderHalfEndControls();applyAppearance();fitRink()

const renderSettingsV58ForV59=renderSettings;

function v59CounterAngle(){return state.halfSide==="left"?-90:90}

/* Version 6.0 — rink-first floating controls and inspectorless puck direction. */
const V60_MIN_SHOT_DISTANCE=250;
const V60_MAX_SHOT_DISTANCE=1120;
const V60_BOARD_ENERGY=.76;
let v60PerimeterCache=null;

function v60PrepareInspectorlessLayout(){

    drawer.hidden=true;drawer.inert=true;drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");

    drawer.style.setProperty("pointer-events","none","important")

  $("#rightDrawerHandle")?.remove();
}

/* Keep the legacy element only as a non-rendered event host.  No Inspector
   controls, including the retired Drop and Shoot-to-ice buttons, are created. */
renderInspector=function(){
  const drawer=$("#rightDrawer"),root=$("#inspectorContent");
  if(root){root.replaceChildren();root.hidden=true;root.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true")}
  if(drawer){drawer.hidden=true;drawer.inert=true;drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");drawer.style.setProperty("display","none","important")}

toggleRight=function(){

openRight=function(){toggleRight(false)};

function v60SetSelectionSource(source){ui.v60SelectionSource=source}

  if((type==="player"||type==="clip")&&ui.playing){stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});ui.playhead=round(ui.playhead,3)}
  ui.v60DirectSelection=(type==="player"||type==="puck")&&source==="rink";
  const result=selectItemV52(type,id,false);
  updateActionContext();
  v60ClearSelectionSource();
  renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);

};

const updateActionContextV510ForV60=updateActionContext;

const setPlayheadV510ForV60=setPlayhead;

  const result=setPlayheadV510ForV60(time,options);renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);return result
};

const togglePlaybackV510ForV60=togglePlayback;

function v60AnchorElement(){
  if(!ui.v60DirectSelection)return null;
  if(ui.selectedType==="player")return $(`#objectLayer [data-player-id="${String(ui.selectedId).replaceAll('"','\\"')}"] .ice-token`)||$(`#objectLayer [data-player-id="${String(ui.selectedId).replaceAll('"','\\"')}"]`);
  if(ui.selectedType==="puck")return $("#puckLayer [data-puck] g")||$("#puckLayer [data-puck]");
  return null
}

function v60PlaceFloating(element,anchorElement,{gap=10}={}){
  const frame=$("#rinkFrame");if(!element||!anchorElement||!frame)return false;
  const frameRect=frame.getBoundingClientRect(),anchorRect=anchorElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(!frameRect.width||!frameRect.height||!anchorRect.width)return false;
  element.hidden=false;element.style.visibility="hidden";element.classList.remove("below");
  const width=element.offsetWidth,height=element.offsetHeight;
  let left=anchorRect.left-frameRect.left+anchorRect.width/2-width/2;
  left=clamp(left,8,Math.max(8,frameRect.width-width-8));
  let top=anchorRect.top-frameRect.top-height-gap;
  if(top<8){top=anchorRect.bottom-frameRect.top+gap;element.classList.add("below")}
  top=clamp(top,8,Math.max(8,frameRect.height-height-8));
  element.style.left=`${round(left,1)}px`;element.style.top=`${round(top,1)}px`;element.style.visibility="visible";return true
}

function v60PuckCanBeDirected(){return puckStateAt(ui.playhead).mode!=="travel"}
function v60ContextMarkup(){
  if(!ui.v60DirectSelection||ui.playing||ui.recordingMove||ui.v60Mode)return"";
  if(ui.selectedType==="player"){
    const player=playerById(ui.selectedId);if(!player||!state.onIce[player.id])return"";
    return `<div class="v60-context-actions" role="group" aria-label="Actions for ${escapeHtml(player.name)}"><button class="v60-float-button primary" data-v60-action="move" type="button">Move</button><button class="v60-float-button secondary" data-v60-action="bench" type="button">Return to bench</button></div>`
  }
  if(ui.selectedType==="puck"&&v60PuckCanBeDirected())return `<div class="v60-context-actions" role="group" aria-label="Puck actions"><button class="v60-float-button primary" data-v60-action="pass" type="button">Pass</button><button class="v60-float-button shot" data-v60-action="shoot" type="button">Shoot</button></div>`;
  return""
}

function v60RenderContextMenu(){
  const menu=$("#v60ContextMenu"),anchor=v60AnchorElement();if(!menu)return;
  const markup=v60ContextMarkup();
  if(!markup||!anchor){menu.hidden=true;menu.innerHTML="";return}
  if(menu.innerHTML!==markup)menu.innerHTML=markup;
  menu.dataset.kind=ui.selectedType||"";
  v60PlaceFloating(menu,anchor,{gap:12})

function v60RenderCancel(){

  const active=!!(ui.recordingMove||ui.v60Mode?.type==="pass"||ui.v60Mode?.type==="shot");button.hidden=!active;
  if(active){button.textContent="Cancel";button.setAttribute("aria-label",ui.recordingMove?"Cancel movement tracing":ui.v60Mode.type==="pass"?"Cancel pass targeting":"Cancel shot aiming")}

function v60RenderShotPanel(){

  if(ui.v60Mode?.type!=="shot"){panel.hidden=true;return}
  const anchor=$("#puckLayer [data-puck] g")||$("#puckLayer [data-puck]");if(!anchor){panel.hidden=true;return}
  const power=clamp(Number(ui.v60Mode.power)||7,1,10),output=panel.querySelector("output"),slider=panel.querySelector("input");
  if(slider&&document.activeElement!==slider)slider.value=String(power);if(output)output.textContent=`${Math.round(power*10)}%`;

function v60RoundedRinkPerimeter(){
  if(v60PerimeterCache)return v60PerimeterCache;
  const b=V59_WORLD_BOUNDS,r=68,points=[];
  const add=p=>{if(!points.length||dist(points.at(-1),p)>.01)points.push({x:round(p.x,4),y:round(p.y,4)})};
  const arc=(cx,cy,a0,a1,steps=14)=>{for(let i=1;i<=steps;i++){const a=(a0+(a1-a0)*i/steps)*Math.PI/180;add({x:cx+Math.cos(a)*r,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r})}};
  add({x:b.minX+r,y:b.minY});add({x:b.maxX-r,y:b.minY});arc(b.maxX-r,b.minY+r,-90,0);
  add({x:b.maxX,y:b.maxY-r});arc(b.maxX-r,b.maxY-r,0,90);
  add({x:b.minX+r,y:b.maxY});arc(b.minX+r,b.maxY-r,90,180);
  add({x:b.minX,y:b.minY+r});arc(b.minX+r,b.minY+r,180,270);
  if(dist(points[0],points.at(-1))>.01)points.push({...points[0]});v60PerimeterCache=points;return points
}

function v60RayBoardHit(start,direction){

  for(let i=0;i<perimeter.length-1;i++){
    const hit=lineIntersection(start,far,perimeter[i],perimeter[i+1]);if(!hit||hit.ta<=.0005||hit.tb<-.0001||hit.tb>1.0001)continue;
    const distance=hit.ta*3000;if(!best||distance<best.distance)best={point:hit.point,distance,index:i,fraction:clamp(hit.tb,0,1)}
  }
  return best
}

function v60FollowPerimeter(hit,direction,remaining){
  const perimeter=v60RoundedRinkPerimeter(),count=perimeter.length-1,a=perimeter[hit.index],b=perimeter[hit.index+1],segmentLength=dist(a,b)||1,forward={x:(b.x-a.x)/segmentLength,y:(b.y-a.y)/segmentLength},dotForward=forward.x*direction.x+forward.y*direction.y,step=dotForward>=0?1:-1,points=[{x:hit.point.x,y:hit.point.y}];let index=hit.index,point={...hit.point},left=Math.max(0,remaining),guard=0;
  while(left>.05&&guard++<count*2){

function v60ShotTravelDistance(power){const p=clamp(Number(power)||7,1,10);return lerp(V60_MIN_SHOT_DISTANCE,V60_MAX_SHOT_DISTANCE,(p-1)/9)}
function v60GoalAlongRay(start,direction,maxDistance){
  if(direction.x>.0001&&start.x<925){const d=(925-start.x)/direction.x,y=start.y+direction.y*d;if(d>0&&d<=maxDistance&&y>=257&&y<=343)return{goal:true,distance:d,path:[{...start},{x:925,y},{x:950,y:clamp(y,266,334)}]}}
  if(direction.x<-.0001&&start.x>75){const d=(75-start.x)/direction.x,y=start.y+direction.y*d;if(d>0&&d<=maxDistance&&y>=257&&y<=343)return{goal:true,distance:d,path:[{...start},{x:75,y},{x:50,y:clamp(y,266,334)}]}}

function v60BuildShotPath(start,aimPoint,power){
  const dx=Number(aimPoint?.x)-start.x,dy=Number(aimPoint?.y)-start.y,mag=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,direction={x:dx/mag,y:dy/mag},travel=v60ShotTravelDistance(power),goal=v60GoalAlongRay(start,direction,travel);

  const hit=v60RayBoardHit(start,direction);if(!hit||travel<=hit.distance+.1){const end={x:start.x+direction.x*travel,y:start.y+direction.y*travel};return{path:[{...start},clampRinkPoint(end)],direction,goal:false,boardFollow:false,distance:travel}}

function v60ModeOrigin(){if(ui.v60Mode?.origin&&Number.isFinite(Number(ui.v60Mode.origin.x)))return{x:Number(ui.v60Mode.origin.x),y:Number(ui.v60Mode.origin.y)};const ps=puckStateAt(ui.playhead);return ps?.pos&&Number.isFinite(ps.pos.x)?{x:ps.pos.x,y:ps.pos.y}:{...state.puckStart}}

}

function v60EventOrigin(event){const result=buildPuckTimeline().results.get(event?.id),start=result?.path?.[0];if(start&&Number.isFinite(Number(start.x)))return deepClone(start);const before=puckStateAt(Math.max(0,(Number(event?.time)||0)-.001));return before?.pos&&Number.isFinite(Number(before.pos.x))?deepClone(before.pos):deepClone(state.puckStart)}
function v60StartPass({editingEventId=null}={}){
  let existing=null,origin=null;if(editingEventId){existing=activeTake().events.find(item=>item.id===editingEventId);if(!existing)return;origin=v60EventOrigin(existing);setPlayhead(existing.time)}
  if(!editingEventId&&!v60PuckCanBeDirected())return toast("Wait for the puck to finish traveling before starting another pass.",2600);
  stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});origin=origin||v60ModeOrigin();ui.v60Mode={type:"pass",origin,point:deepClone(origin),editingEventId};ui.targetMode={type:"pass"};ui.possessionTargetId=null;ui.v60DirectSelection=false;renderFrame(ui.playhead)

function v60StartShot({editingEventId=null}={}){
  let existing=null,origin=null;if(editingEventId){existing=activeTake().events.find(item=>item.id===editingEventId);if(!existing)return;origin=v60EventOrigin(existing);setPlayhead(existing.time)}
  if(!editingEventId&&!v60PuckCanBeDirected())return toast("Wait for the puck to finish traveling before taking a shot.",2600);
  stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});origin=origin||v60ModeOrigin();const power=clamp(Number(existing?.power||ui.puckOptions?.shotPower)||7,1,10),aim=existing?.aimVector?{x:origin.x+Number(existing.aimVector.x||0)*260,y:origin.y+Number(existing.aimVector.y||0)*260}:existing?.target||v60DefaultShotAim(origin);ui.v60Mode={type:"shot",origin,aim:deepClone(aim),power,editingEventId};ui.targetMode={type:"shot-v60"};ui.possessionTargetId=null;ui.v60DirectSelection=false;renderFrame(ui.playhead)
}

function v60ResetTransientState(){ui.v60Mode=null;ui.v60ShotDrag=null;ui.targetMode=null;ui.possessionTargetId=null}
function v60CancelTransientMode({clearSelection=true,render=true}={}){
  if(ui.recordingMove){cancelMoveRecording();if(clearSelection){ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;ui.v60DirectSelection=false}}
  v60ResetTransientState();if(clearSelection){ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;ui.v60DirectSelection=false}

addPass=function(targetId,time=ui.playhead){

function v60RenderModePreview(){

  if(ui.recordingMove)return;
  layer.innerHTML="";layer.style.removeProperty("--v60-shot-dash-speed");const mode=ui.v60Mode;if(!mode)return;const origin=v60ModeOrigin();

    if(!targetId){const g=svgEl("g",{class:"v60-open-target",transform:`translate(${round(target.x,2)} ${round(target.y,2)})`});g.append(svgEl("circle",{r:13}));g.append(svgEl("path",{d:"M-19 0H19M0-19V19"}));layer.append(g)}

    layer.append(svgEl("path",{d:pathD(built.path),class:"v60-shot-preview v60-shot-preview-red"}));

const renderFrameV510ForV60=renderFrame;
renderFrame=function(time=ui.playhead){const result=renderFrameV510ForV60(time);renderV60SpatialUI(time);return result};

const renderTimelineV510ForV60=renderTimeline;

function renderV60TimelineContext(){

  if(ui.selectedType==="clip"){
    const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(item=>item.id===ui.selectedId),player=clip?playerById(clip.playerId):null;if(!clip||!player){root.hidden=true;root.innerHTML="";return}
    const bounds=movementNeighborBounds(clip),end=clip.start+clip.duration;
    root.hidden=false;root.innerHTML=`<span class="v60-timeline-chip"><strong>${escapeHtml(player.name)}</strong><span>${fmtTime(clip.start)}–${fmtTime(end)}</span></span><button class="btn small primary" data-v60-timeline="move-from" type="button">Move from ${fmtTime(ui.playhead)}</button><button class="btn small" data-v60-timeline="continue-clip" type="button">Continue after clip</button><label class="v60-timeline-number"><span>Start</span><input id="v60ClipStart" type="number" min="${round(bounds.minStart,2)}" max="${round(bounds.maxStart,2)}" step=".05" value="${round(clip.start,2)}" aria-label="Movement clip start in seconds"><em>s</em></label><label class="v60-timeline-number"><span>Duration</span><input id="v60ClipDuration" type="number" min=".05" max="${round(Math.max(.05,bounds.maxDuration),2)}" step=".05" value="${round(clip.duration,2)}" aria-label="Movement clip duration in seconds"><em>s</em></label><button class="btn small" data-v60-timeline="preview-clip" type="button">Preview</button><button class="btn small danger" data-v60-timeline="delete-clip" type="button">Delete</button>`;return
  }
  if(ui.selectedType==="event"){
    const event=activeTake().events.find(item=>item.id===ui.selectedId);if(!event){root.hidden=true;root.innerHTML="";return}const label=event.type==="pass"?"Pass":event.type==="passSpace"?"Pass to ice":event.type==="shot"?"Shot":event.type==="possess"?"Possession":event.type==="drop"?"Drop":event.type;
    const canRetarget=event.type==="pass"||event.type==="passSpace"||event.type==="shot";
    root.hidden=false;root.innerHTML=`<span class="v60-timeline-chip"><strong>${escapeHtml(label)}</strong><span>${fmtTime(event.time)}</span></span><label class="v60-timeline-number"><span>Time</span><input id="v60EventTime" type="number" min="0" max="${round(state.timeline.duration,2)}" step=".05" value="${round(event.time,2)}" aria-label="Puck event time in seconds"><em>s</em></label><button class="btn small" data-v60-timeline="playhead-event" type="button">Set playhead</button>${canRetarget?`<button class="btn small primary" data-v60-timeline="retarget-event" type="button">${event.type==="shot"?"Edit shot":"Retarget"}</button>`:""}<button class="btn small danger" data-v60-timeline="delete-event" type="button">Delete</button>`;return
  }
  root.hidden=true;root.innerHTML=""
}

function v60PlayerDropTarget(point,time=0){
  let best=null;for(const id of Object.keys(state.onIce)){const player=playerById(id);if(!player||player.role==="coach"||player.role==="manager")continue;const position=playerPositionAt(id,time),distance=dist(point,position);if(distance<=40&&(!best||distance<best.distance))best={id,distance}}
  return best?.id||null
}

const onRinkPointerDownV510ForV60=onRinkPointerDown;
onRinkPointerDown=function(event){
  v60SetSelectionSource("rink");
  const playerNode=event.target.closest?.("[data-player-id]"),puckNode=event.target.closest?.("[data-puck]");
  if(ui.v60Mode?.type==="pass"){
    event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();if(playerNode)v60CommitPassToPlayer(playerNode.dataset.playerId);else if(!puckNode)v60CommitPassToPoint(svgPoint(event));return
  }
  if(ui.v60Mode?.type==="shot"){
    event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();if(!puckNode){ui.v60ShotDrag={pointerId:event.pointerId};ui.v60Mode.aim=svgPoint(event);try{$("#rinkSvg").setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)}catch{}renderFrame(ui.playhead)}return
  }

};

const onRinkPointerMoveV510ForV60=onRinkPointerMove;

  if(ui.v60Mode?.type==="pass"){
    const playerNode=event.target.closest?.("[data-player-id]");ui.v60Mode.point=playerNode?stickPosition(playerNode.dataset.playerId,ui.playhead):svgPoint(event);renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);return

    ui.v60Mode.aim=svgPoint(event);renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);return

};

const onRinkPointerUpV510ForV60=onRinkPointerUp;
onRinkPointerUp=function(event){
  if(ui.v60Mode?.type==="shot"&&ui.v60ShotDrag?.pointerId===event.pointerId){ui.v60ShotDrag=null;try{$("#rinkSvg").releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId)}catch{}renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);return}
  if(ui.dragPuck?.pointerId===event.pointerId){
    const drag=ui.dragPuck;ui.dragPuck=null;
    if(drag.moved){
      const previous=JSON.parse(snapshot());previous.puckStart=drag.origin;const priorOption=previous.variations?.find(item=>item.id===previous.activeVariationId);if(priorOption)priorOption.puckStart=deepClone(drag.origin);ui.history.push(JSON.stringify(previous));if(ui.history.length>80)ui.history.shift();ui.future=[];
      const targetId=v60PlayerDropTarget(state.puckStart,0);if(targetId){state.puckStart=stickPosition(targetId,0);activeTake().events.push({id:uid("pe"),type:"possess",targetId,time:0,order:Date.now()+Math.random()});toast(`${playerById(targetId)?.name||"Player"} starts with the puck.`,1800)}
      ui.v60DirectSelection=false;ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;renderAll();scheduleSave()
    }else{v60SetSelectionSource("rink");selectItem("puck","puck",false)}
    return
  }
  const result=onRinkPointerUpV510ForV60(event);if(!ui.pendingTap&&!ui.dragSetup&&!ui.dragPuck)v60ClearSelectionSource();return result
};

const onRinkPointerCancelV510ForV60=onRinkPointerCancel;

startDirectPlayerMove=function(playerId,mode="playhead",explicitTime=null){
  const player=playerById(playerId);if(!player||!state.onIce[playerId])return;
  if(ui.playing)stopPlayback({keepDirect:false});if(ui.recordingMove)cancelMoveRecording();v60ResetTransientState();
  const requested=explicitTime!==null&&explicitTime!==undefined&&Number.isFinite(Number(explicitTime))?Number(explicitTime):mode==="continuation"?continuationTimeForPlayer(playerId,ui.playhead):ui.playhead,startTime=round(clamp(requested,0,state.timeline.duration),3),startPosition=deepClone(playerPositionAt(playerId,startTime));

  const rec=ui.recordingMove;if(!rec?.started||rec.points.length<2){cancelMoveRecording();return}
  const elapsed=Math.max(.35,(performance.now()-rec.startStamp)/1000),duration=clamp(elapsed,.35,Math.max(.35,Math.min(20,60-rec.startTime))),payload={playerId:rec.playerId,startTime:rec.startTime,startPosition:deepClone(rec.startPosition),points:deepClone(rec.points),duration};

buildPuckTimeline=function(){
  const take=activeTake(),events=[...take.events].sort((a,b)=>a.time-b.time||(a.order||0)-(b.order||0)),intervals=[],results=new Map();let cursor=0,mode="loose",holder=null,loose={...state.puckStart};
  const addSteady=end=>{if(end>cursor+.0001){intervals.push({start:cursor,end,kind:mode,holder,pos:loose});cursor=end}};
  for(const event of events){
    event.time=clamp(Number(event.time)||0,0,state.timeline.duration);let overridePos=null;
    if(event.time<cursor-.015){
      if(!event.replace){results.set(event.id,{valid:false,reason:"Overlaps an earlier puck flight",arrival:cursor});continue}
      const last=intervals.at(-1);if(last&&event.time>=last.start-.001&&event.time<last.end){if(last.kind==="travel"){const progress=(event.time-last.start)/Math.max(.001,last.end-last.start);last.path=slicePolylineByProgress(last.path,0,progress);overridePos={...last.path.at(-1)};last.end=event.time;const prior=results.get(last.eventId);if(prior)results.set(last.eventId,{...prior,arrival:event.time,path:deepClone(last.path),overridden:true})}else{last.end=event.time;overridePos=last.kind==="attached"&&last.holder?stickPosition(last.holder,event.time):deepClone(last.pos||loose)}}cursor=event.time
    }
    addSteady(event.time);const at=event.time,currentPos=event.from?deepClone(event.from):overridePos||(mode==="attached"&&holder?stickPosition(holder,at):{...loose});
    if(event.type==="place"){mode="loose";holder=null;loose=clampRinkPoint(event.target||currentPos);cursor=at;results.set(event.id,{valid:true,arrival:at,path:[currentPos,loose],replace:!!event.replace});continue}
    if(event.type==="possess"){if(!state.onIce[event.targetId]){results.set(event.id,{valid:false,reason:"Target is not on the ice"});continue}mode="attached";holder=event.targetId;cursor=at;results.set(event.id,{valid:true,arrival:at,source:null,target:event.targetId,path:[currentPos,stickPosition(event.targetId,at)],replace:!!event.replace});continue}
    if(event.type==="drop"){mode="loose";holder=null;loose=currentPos;cursor=at;results.set(event.id,{valid:true,arrival:at,path:[currentPos]});continue}
    if(event.type==="pass"){
      if(!state.onIce[event.targetId]||(mode==="attached"&&event.targetId===holder)){results.set(event.id,{valid:false,reason:"Choose another on-ice receiver"});continue}
      const source=mode==="attached"?holder:null,start=source?stickPosition(source,at):currentPos,speed=passSpeedUnits(event.speed||6),prediction=predictReceiverTarget(event.targetId,at,start,speed);let path=[start,prediction.point],length=polylineLength(path),arrival=at+length/speed,collision=null;
      if(!event.ignoreDefense){collision=firstCollisionOnPath(path,at,arrival,[source,event.targetId].filter(Boolean));if(collision){const bank=boardBankPath(start,prediction.point);if(bank){const bankArrival=at+bank.length/speed,bankHit=firstCollisionOnPath(bank.points,at,bankArrival,[source,event.targetId].filter(Boolean));if(!bankHit){path=bank.points;length=bank.length;arrival=bankArrival;collision=null}}}}
      if(collision){intervals.push({start:at,end:collision.time,kind:"travel",path:[start,collision.point],spin:true,sauce:!!event.sauce,eventId:event.id});cursor=collision.time;mode="loose";holder=null;loose=collision.point;results.set(event.id,{valid:true,blocked:true,source,target:event.targetId,arrival:collision.time,path:[start,collision.point],collision});continue}
      intervals.push({start:at,end:arrival,kind:"travel",path,spin:true,sauce:!!event.sauce,eventId:event.id});cursor=arrival;mode="attached";holder=event.targetId;results.set(event.id,{valid:true,source,target:event.targetId,arrival,path,bank:path.length>2});continue
    }
    if(event.type==="passSpace"){
      const source=mode==="attached"?holder:null,start=source?stickPosition(source,at):currentPos,target=clampRinkPoint(event.target||currentPos),speed=passSpeedUnits(event.speed||6);let path=[start,target],arrival=at+polylineLength(path)/speed,collision=null;
      if(!event.ignoreDefense)collision=firstCollisionOnPath(path,at,arrival,source?[source]:[]);
      if(collision){path=[start,collision.point];arrival=collision.time}
      intervals.push({start:at,end:arrival,kind:"travel",path,spin:true,sauce:!!event.sauce,eventId:event.id});cursor=arrival;mode="loose";holder=null;loose=path.at(-1);results.set(event.id,{valid:true,source,target:null,arrival,path,collision,passToSpace:true});continue
    }
    if(event.type==="shot"){
      const source=mode==="attached"?holder:null,start=source?stickPosition(source,at):currentPos,power=event.power||6;let built=null;
      if(event.aimVector&&Number.isFinite(Number(event.aimVector.x))&&Number.isFinite(Number(event.aimVector.y)))built=v60BuildShotPath(start,{x:start.x+Number(event.aimVector.x)*200,y:start.y+Number(event.aimVector.y)*200},power);
      const target=clampRinkPoint(event.target||currentPos),legacyGoal=built?{goal:built.goal}:goalResultForShot(start,target);let path=built?built.path:(legacyGoal.goal?[start,legacyGoal.entry,legacyGoal.end]:[start,target]),arrival=at+polylineLength(path)/shotSpeedUnits(power),collision=null,goal=!!(built?.goal||legacyGoal.goal);
      if(!event.ignoreDefense)collision=firstCollisionOnPath(path,at,arrival,source?[source]:[]);
      if(collision){path=[start,collision.point];arrival=collision.time;goal=false;const v={x:collision.point.x-start.x,y:collision.point.y-start.y},m=Math.hypot(v.x,v.y)||1,hash=[...String(event.id)].reduce((n,ch)=>(n*33+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0,5381),jx=hash%17-8,jy=(hash>>>5)%17-8,rebound=clampRinkPoint({x:collision.point.x-v.x/m*18+jx,y:collision.point.y-v.y/m*18+jy});path.push(rebound);arrival+=.16}
      intervals.push({start:at,end:arrival,kind:"travel",path,spin:true,eventId:event.id,goal,boardFollow:!!built?.boardFollow});cursor=arrival;mode="loose";holder=null;loose=path.at(-1);results.set(event.id,{valid:true,source,target:null,arrival,path,goal,collision,boardFollow:!!built?.boardFollow});continue
    }
  }
  addSteady(state.timeline.duration+5);return{intervals,results,events}
};

function setupV60Events(){
  const layer=$("#v60ContextLayer");
  layer?.addEventListener("click",event=>{
    const action=event.target.closest("[data-v60-action]")?.dataset.v60Action;if(action==="move"&&ui.selectedType==="player")startDirectPlayerMove(ui.selectedId,"playhead",ui.playhead);else if(action==="bench"&&ui.selectedType==="player")returnToBench(ui.selectedId);else if(action==="pass")v60StartPass();else if(action==="shoot")v60StartShot();else if(action==="commit-shot")v60CommitShot();else if(action==="cancel")v60CancelTransientMode({clearSelection:true})
  });
  $("#v60ShotPower")?.addEventListener("input",event=>{if(ui.v60Mode?.type!=="shot")return;ui.v60Mode.power=clamp(Number(event.target.value)||7,1,10);ui.puckOptions.shotPower=ui.v60Mode.power;renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead)});
  $("#v60TimelineContext")?.addEventListener("click",event=>{
    const action=event.target.closest("[data-v60-timeline]")?.dataset.v60Timeline;if(!action)return;
    if(action==="delete-clip"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(item=>item.id===ui.selectedId);if(!clip)return;pushHistory();state.timeline.movements=state.timeline.movements.filter(item=>item.id!==clip.id);ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;renderAll()}
    else if(action==="move-from"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(item=>item.id===ui.selectedId);if(clip)startDirectPlayerMove(clip.playerId,"playhead",ui.playhead)}
    else if(action==="continue-clip"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(item=>item.id===ui.selectedId);if(clip)startDirectPlayerMove(clip.playerId,"continuation",clip.start+clip.duration)}
    else if(action==="preview-clip"){const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(item=>item.id===ui.selectedId);if(clip){setPlayhead(clip.start);if(!ui.playing)togglePlayback()}}
    else if(action==="delete-event"){pushHistory();activeTake().events=activeTake().events.filter(item=>item.id!==ui.selectedId);ui.selectedType=null;ui.selectedId=null;renderAll()}
    else if(action==="playhead-event"){const item=activeTake().events.find(eventItem=>eventItem.id===ui.selectedId);if(item)setPlayhead(item.time)}
    else if(action==="retarget-event"){const item=activeTake().events.find(eventItem=>eventItem.id===ui.selectedId);if(item){if(item.type==="shot")v60StartShot({editingEventId:item.id});else v60StartPass({editingEventId:item.id})}}
  });
  $("#v60TimelineContext")?.addEventListener("change",event=>{
    if(event.target.id==="v60ClipDuration"||event.target.id==="v60ClipStart"){
      const clip=state.timeline.movements.find(item=>item.id===ui.selectedId);if(!clip)return;pushHistory();const bounds=movementNeighborBounds(clip);if(event.target.id==="v60ClipStart")clip.start=round(clamp(Number(event.target.value)||0,bounds.minStart,bounds.maxStart),3);else clip.duration=round(clamp(Number(event.target.value)||clip.duration,.05,bounds.maxDuration),3);sanitizeMovementTracks(clip.playerId);renderAll();return
    }
    if(event.target.id==="v60EventTime"){
      const item=activeTake().events.find(eventItem=>eventItem.id===ui.selectedId);if(!item)return;pushHistory();item.time=round(clamp(Number(event.target.value)||0,0,state.timeline.duration),3);ui.playhead=item.time;renderAll()
    }
  });
  $("#timelineGrid")?.addEventListener("pointerdown",()=>{v60SetSelectionSource("timeline");ui.v60DirectSelection=false;renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead)},true);
  $("#commandBar")?.addEventListener("pointerdown",()=>{ui.v60DirectSelection=false;renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead)},true);
  window.addEventListener("resize",()=>renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead));
  document.addEventListener("keydown",event=>{if(event.key==="Escape"&&(ui.v60Mode||ui.recordingMove)){event.preventDefault();v60CancelTransientMode({clearSelection:true})}},true)
}

/* Version 6.1 — editable action timing, refined shot creation, ice-like puck
   travel, timeline glow controls, pinch zoom, Pencil scrubbing, and smart ink. */

const V61_VERSION="6.1";
const V61_MARKER_DEFAULTS={style:"solid",mode:"freehand",arrowEnd:"open"};
const V61_ZOOM_MIN=1;
const V61_ZOOM_MAX=3.5;

function v61EnsureDataShape(output){
  if(!output||typeof output!=="object")return output;
  output.version=APP_VERSION;
  output.playbookName=String(output.playbookName||"").replace(/v6\.[0-2]/gi,"v6.3")||"BOTD Playbook v6.8";
  output.marker={color:"#111827",width:6,...V61_MARKER_DEFAULTS,...(output.marker||{})};
  output.puckGlow={enabled:false,color:"#39D8FF",brightness:70,blink:false,rate:1.2,...(output.puckGlow||{})};
  for(const player of [...(output.rosters?.A||[]),...(output.rosters?.B||[])]){
    player.glow={enabled:false,color:null,brightness:68,blink:false,rate:1.2,...(player.glow||{})};
  }
  const normalizeTimeline=timeline=>{
    if(!timeline)return;
    for(const clip of timeline.movements||[]){
      clip.duration=clamp(Number(clip.duration)||.5,.05,60);
      if(!Number.isFinite(Number(clip.baselineDuration)))clip.baselineDuration=clip.duration;
    }
    for(const take of timeline.puckTakes||[]){
      for(const event of take.events||[]){
        if(event.travelDuration!==undefined&&event.travelDuration!==null){
          const n=Number(event.travelDuration);event.travelDuration=Number.isFinite(n)?clamp(n,.05,30):undefined;
        }
      }
    }
  };
  normalizeTimeline(output.timeline);
  for(const option of output.variations||[])normalizeTimeline(option.timeline);
  for(const stroke of output.drawings||[]){
    stroke.style=stroke.style||"solid";stroke.mode=stroke.mode||"freehand";stroke.arrowEnd=stroke.arrowEnd||"open";
  }
  for(const option of output.variations||[])for(const stroke of option.drawings||[]){
    stroke.style=stroke.style||"solid";stroke.mode=stroke.mode||"freehand";stroke.arrowEnd=stroke.arrowEnd||"open";
  }
  return output
}

const makeDefaultStateV60ForV61=makeDefaultState;
makeDefaultState=function(){
  const output=makeDefaultStateV60ForV61();
  output.version=APP_VERSION;output.playbookName="BOTD Playbook v6.8";
  output.marker={color:"#111827",width:6,...V61_MARKER_DEFAULTS};
  output.puckGlow={enabled:false,color:"#39D8FF",brightness:70,blink:false,rate:1.2};
  return v61EnsureDataShape(output)
};
const normalizeStateV60ForV61=normalizeState;

  }

function v61SyncMarkerDialog(){

/* ---------- Contextual timeline timing and glow ---------- */
function v61PlayerGlow(player){

}
function v61GlowMarkup(kind,id){
  const player=kind==="player"?playerById(id):null,glow=player?v61PlayerGlow(player):(state.puckGlow={enabled:false,color:"#39D8FF",brightness:70,blink:false,rate:1.2,...(state.puckGlow||{})});

}
function v61ClipBounds(clip){

}

  if(result?.arrival>event.time)return result.arrival-event.time;return .5
}

  const events=[...activeTake().events].sort((a,b)=>a.time-b.time||(a.order||0)-(b.order||0)),index=events.findIndex(item=>item.id===event.id),next=index>=0?events.slice(index+1).find(item=>item.time>event.time+.02):null,max=next?next.time-event.time-.02:Math.min(30,state.timeline.duration-event.time);

renderV60TimelineContext=function(){

    const canRetarget=event.type==="pass"||event.type==="passSpace"||event.type==="shot",hasTravel=canRetarget,result=buildPuckTimeline().results.get(event.id),duration=hasTravel?v61EventDuration(event):0,bounds=hasTravel?v61EventDurationBounds(event):null,length=result?.path?polylineLength(result.path):0;

  }

  }
  if(ui.selectedType==="puck"){
    root.hidden=false;root.innerHTML=`<div class="v61-timeline-editor"><span class="v60-timeline-chip"><strong>Puck</strong><span>${escapeHtml(activeTake().name)}</span></span>${v61GlowMarkup("puck","puck")}</div>`;return

function v61UpdateRangeReadouts(input){

      }

    }

      intervals.push({start:at,end:arrival,kind:"travel",path,spin:true,sauce:!!event.sauce,eventId:event.id,motion:"pass"});cursor=arrival;mode="attached";holder=event.targetId;results.set(event.id,{valid:true,source,target:event.targetId,arrival,duration,path,bank:path.length>2});continue
    }

    }
