        const previous=path.length>1?path.at(-2):start,v={x:collision.point.x-previous.x,y:collision.point.y-previous.y},m=Math.hypot(v.x,v.y)||1,hash=[...String(event.id)].reduce((n,ch)=>(n*33+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0,5381),jx=hash%13-6,jy=(hash>>>5)%13-6,rebound=clampRinkPoint({x:collision.point.x-v.x/m*15+jx,y:collision.point.y-v.y/m*15+jy});path.push(rebound);arrival+=.18
      }
      intervals.push({start:at,end:arrival,kind:"travel",path,spin:true,eventId:event.id,goal,boardFollow:!!built?.boardFollow,motion:"shot",power});cursor=arrival;mode="loose";holder=null;loose=path.at(-1);results.set(event.id,{valid:true,source,target:null,arrival,duration:arrival-at,path,goal,collision,boardFollow:!!built?.boardFollow,power});continue
    }

puckStateAt=function(time,timeline=buildPuckTimeline()){
  const interval=timeline.intervals.find(item=>time>=item.start-.0001&&time<=item.end+.0001)||timeline.intervals.at(-1);
  if(!interval)return{mode:"loose",pos:{...state.puckStart},holder:null,spin:false};
  if(interval.kind==="attached")return{mode:"attached",holder:interval.holder,pos:stickPosition(interval.holder,time),spin:false,interval};
  if(interval.kind==="travel"){
    const raw=clamp((time-interval.start)/Math.max(.001,interval.end-interval.start),0,1);let progress=raw;
    if(interval.motion==="shot")progress=1-Math.pow(1-raw,interval.boardFollow?1.58:1.35);

    return{mode:"travel",holder:null,pos:pointAtPolyline(interval.path,progress),spin:true,sauce:interval.sauce,goal:interval.goal,interval,progress}
  }

/* A denser, angle-aware wall path makes rims and banks look smooth on ice. */
v60RoundedRinkPerimeter=function(){
  if(v60PerimeterCache?.v61)return v60PerimeterCache;const b=V59_WORLD_BOUNDS,r=68,points=[];
  const add=p=>{if(!points.length||dist(points.at(-1),p)>.01)points.push({x:round(p.x,4),y:round(p.y,4)})};

v60ShotTravelDistance=function(power){const p=clamp(Number(power)||7,1,10),u=(p-1)/9;return lerp(145,1480,Math.pow(u,.9))};

/* The corner Cancel remains available while aiming. Once the local power card

/* Direct board impacts now ricochet. Shallow impacts retain the useful rim/
   wall-follow behavior. The back and both side meshes of each net are physical
   surfaces and absorb more energy than the boards. */
v60BuildShotPath=function(start,aimPoint,power){
  const rawStart={x:Number(start?.x)||0,y:Number(start?.y)||0},dx=Number(aimPoint?.x)-rawStart.x,dy=Number(aimPoint?.y)-rawStart.y,mag=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,initial={x:dx/mag,y:dy/mag};

    const tangent=v64Unit({x:surface.b.x-surface.a.x,y:surface.b.y-surface.a.y}),glance=Math.abs(tangent.x*direction.x+tangent.y*direction.y);

    const retention=surface.kind==="net"?lerp(.43,.61,glance):lerp(.58,.77,glance);direction=v64Reflect(direction,surface.a,surface.b);remaining*=retention;bounced=true;bounceCount++;if(surface.kind==="net")netBounce=true;
    current=v64ClampPlayablePoint({x:surface.point.x+direction.x*.9,y:surface.point.y+direction.y*.9},.35);v64AppendPoint(path,current)
  }
  if(remaining>.75){const surface=v64NearestShotSurface(current,direction,remaining);v64AppendPoint(path,surface?surface.point:v64ClampPlayablePoint({x:current.x+direction.x*remaining,y:current.y+direction.y*remaining},.35))}

function v64RenderAimPreview(layer,origin,mode){

/* Mouse aiming is hover-to-preview, click-to-lock. Pen/touch aiming is
   contact-drag-to-preview, lift-to-lock. Once locked, rink pointer movement can

const onRinkPointerDownV63ForV64=onRinkPointerDown;

    if(event.target.closest?.("[data-puck]"))return;

    if(event.pointerType==="mouse"){ui.v60Mode.stage="power";ui.v60ShotDrag=null;renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);return}
    ui.v60ShotDrag={pointerId:event.pointerId,pointerType:event.pointerType||"touch"};try{$("#rinkSvg").setPointerCapture(event.pointerId)}catch{}renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);return

    if(ui.v60ShotDrag?.pointerId===event.pointerId){const samples=event.getCoalescedEvents?event.getCoalescedEvents():[event],last=samples.at(-1)||event;ui.v60Mode.aim=svgPoint(last);ui.v60Mode.lastPointerType=event.pointerType||ui.v60ShotDrag.pointerType;renderV60SpatialUI(ui.playhead);return}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Version 6.5 — playback-safe Glow/Blink, duration-width puck actions, and
   conditional Telestration track visibility.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const V65_VERSION="6.5";

function v65PrepareVersionText(){
  document.title=`BOTD Hockey Coaching Aid v${APP_VERSION}`;
  document.documentElement.dataset.appVersion=APP_VERSION;
  for(const entry of Object.values(I18N||{})){
    if(entry?.appSubtitle)entry.appSubtitle=entry.appSubtitle.replace(/6\.\d+/g,APP_VERSION)
  }
  const subtitle=document.querySelector(".brand-copy span");
  if(subtitle)subtitle.textContent=I18N[state?.appearance?.language||"en"]?.appSubtitle||`Hockey Playbook Studio · Version ${APP_VERSION}`
}
function v65EnsureVersionState(){
  if(!state)return;
  state.version=APP_VERSION;
  if(/^BOTD Playbook v6\.4$/i.test(String(state.playbookName||"")))state.playbookName="BOTD Playbook v6.8";
  for(const option of state.variations||[])option.version=APP_VERSION
}

/* CSS animations restarted every time the moving SVG token was rebuilt on an
   animation frame. Render the Glow/Blink phase directly from timeline time so
   it remains visible while both the player/puck and playhead are moving. */
const v63GlowVisualV64ForV65=v63GlowVisual;
v63GlowVisual=function(kind,id,time=ui.playhead){
  const timelineTime=Number(time)||0,clip=v63ActiveGlow(kind,id,timelineTime);
  if(!clip)return{enabled:false,...V63_GLOW_DEFAULTS,timelineTime};
  return{enabled:true,color:clip.color,brightness:clip.brightness,blink:clip.blink,rate:clip.rate,start:clip.start,timelineTime,clipId:clip.id}
};
const setGlowStyleV64ForV65=setGlowStyle;
setGlowStyle=function(node,glow,defaultColor){
  if(!node||!glow?.enabled)return;
  const color=glow.color||defaultColor||"#39D8FF",size=4+(Number(glow.brightness)||65)/8,rate=Math.max(.2,Number(glow.rate)||1.2),timelineTime=Number(glow.timelineTime??ui.playhead)||0,start=Number(glow.start)||0;
  const puckShadow=node.classList?.contains("puck-disc")?"drop-shadow(2px 4px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.47)) ":"";
  const glowFilter=`drop-shadow(0 0 ${size.toFixed(2)}px ${color}) drop-shadow(0 0 ${(size*1.8).toFixed(2)}px ${color})`;
  let phaseOn=true;
  if(glow.blink===true&&ui.playing){
    const phase=((((timelineTime-start)*rate)%1)+1)%1;
    phaseOn=phase<.56
  }
  const filter=phaseOn?`${puckShadow}${glowFilter}`:(puckShadow.trim()||"none");
  node.classList.remove("player-glow","puck-glow-static");
  node.classList.add("v65-timeline-glow");
  node.style.setProperty("--glow-color",color);
  node.style.setProperty("--glow-size",`${size}px`);
  node.style.filter=filter;
  node.style.webkitFilter=filter;
  node.dataset.v65GlowPhase=phaseOn?"on":"off";
  node.dataset.v65GlowClip=String(glow.clipId||"")
};

/* Static Telestration remains visible on the rink, but it should not consume a
   timeline row until the coach enables timeline playback. */
const v63AddTelestrationTrackV64ForV65=v63AddTelestrationTrack;
v63AddTelestrationTrack=function(){
  const grid=$("#timelineGrid");
  grid?.querySelector(".v63-telestration-row")?.remove();
  if(!v63Telestration().enabled)return;
  return v63AddTelestrationTrackV64ForV65()
};

function v65PuckActionLabel(event){
  if(event.type==="shot")return"Shot";
  if(event.type==="passSpace")return"Pass to space";
  if(event.type==="pass")return`Pass → ${playerById(event.targetId)?.name||"player"}`;
  return event.type
}
function v65DecoratePuckActionClips(){
  const lane=$("[data-track='puck']");
  if(!lane)return;
  const px=timelinePx(),timeline=buildPuckTimeline(),nodes=[...lane.querySelectorAll("[data-event-id]")];
  for(const event of timeline.events){
    if(!["pass","passSpace","shot"].includes(event.type))continue;
    const result=timeline.results.get(event.id),start=Number(event.time)||0,end=Number(result?.arrival),node=nodes.find(item=>item.dataset.eventId===event.id);
    if(!node||result?.valid===false||!Number.isFinite(end)||end<=start+.005)continue;
    const duration=Math.max(.005,end-start),label=v65PuckActionLabel(event);
    node.classList.add("v65-puck-action-clip");
    if(event.type==="passSpace")node.classList.add("passSpace");
    node.style.left=`${start*px}px`;
    node.style.width=`${Math.max(34,duration*px)}px`;
    node.style.transform="none";
    node.dataset.v65ActionStart=String(start);
    node.dataset.v65ActionEnd=String(end);
    node.title=`${label} · ${fmtTime(start)}–${fmtTime(end)} · ${duration.toFixed(2)} s`;
    node.setAttribute("aria-label",node.title);
    const span=node.nextElementSibling;
    if(span?.classList.contains("travel-span")){
      span.classList.add("v65-replaced-travel-span");
      span.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true")
    }
  }
}

const renderTimelineV64ForV65=renderTimeline;
renderTimeline=function(){
  const result=renderTimelineV64ForV65();
  v65DecoratePuckActionClips();
  return result
};

function setupV65Events(){
  const context=$("#v60TimelineContext");
  if(context&&context.dataset.v65Events!=="1"){
    context.dataset.v65Events="1";
    context.addEventListener("input",event=>{
      const role=event.target?.dataset?.v61Role;
      if(role==="event-duration"||role==="shot-power")requestAnimationFrame(v65DecoratePuckActionClips)
    },true)
  }
  const toggle=$("#telestrationPlaybackToggle");
  if(toggle){
    toggle.title="Show the Telestration timeline and record marker/eraser actions";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-label","Enable Telestration timeline playback")
  }
}

const initV64ForV65=init;
init=function(){
  window.__BOTD_READY=false;
  v65PrepareVersionText();
  initV64ForV65();
  v65EnsureVersionState();
  v65PrepareVersionText();
  setupV65Events();
  renderAll();
  window.__BOTD_READY=true;
  toast("Version 6.5: Glow and Blink now remain visible during motion, puck actions fill their complete timeline duration, and the Telestration track stays hidden until enabled.",5200)
};

Object.assign(window.BOTD_TEST,{
  version:APP_VERSION,
  glowVisualV65:(kind,id,time)=>deepClone(v63GlowVisual(kind,id,time)),
  glowNodeState:selector=>{const node=document.querySelector(selector);return node?{filter:node.style.filter,phase:node.dataset.v65GlowPhase,clip:node.dataset.v65GlowClip}:null},
  puckActionClips:()=>[...document.querySelectorAll(".v65-puck-action-clip")].map(node=>({id:node.dataset.eventId,start:Number(node.dataset.v65ActionStart),end:Number(node.dataset.v65ActionEnd),width:node.getBoundingClientRect().width,label:node.textContent.trim()})),
  telestrationTrackVisible:()=>!!document.querySelector(".v63-telestration-row")
});

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Version 6.6 — content-aware playback independent of Glow/Blink, refreshed
   BOTD artwork, and explicit token-display defaults.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const V66_VERSION="6.6";

/* Glow and Blink are presentation intervals, not actions that should extend
   the play. Movement, puck travel/events, and enabled timed Telestration still
   determine the natural playback endpoint. */
function v66PlaybackContentEnd(){
  let end=Number(contentEndV62ForV63());
  if(!Number.isFinite(end))end=0;
  const telestration=v63Telestration();
  if(telestration?.enabled){
    for(const action of v63TelestrationActions()){
      const actionEnd=(Number(action.start)||0)+(Number(action.duration)||0);
      if(Number.isFinite(actionEnd))end=Math.max(end,actionEnd)
    }
  }
  return round(clamp(end,0,state.timeline.duration),3)
}
v64PlaybackEnd=function(){return v66PlaybackContentEnd()};

/* Keep the exact requested token-display choices for brand-new boards while
   preserving the preferences already stored in an existing session. */
const makeDefaultStateV65ForV66=makeDefaultState;
makeDefaultState=function(){
  const output=makeDefaultStateV65ForV66();
  output.version=APP_VERSION;
  output.playbookName="BOTD Playbook v6.8";
  output.display={...(output.display||{}),names:false,numbers:true,positions:true,leadership:false,offside:true};
  return output
};

function v66SyncBrandArtwork(){
  const logo=$("#brandLogo");
  if(logo){
    const source=state?.playbookLogo||PLAYBOOK_LOGO_DEFAULT;
    if(logo.getAttribute("src")!==source)logo.setAttribute("src",source)
  }
  const center=state?.centerLogo||CENTER_LOGO_DEFAULT;
  $("#centerLogoFull")?.setAttribute("href",center);
  $("#centerLogoHalf")?.setAttribute("href",center)
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Version 6.8 — settled playback endpoints, corrected fresh display defaults,
   and precisely centered goalie numbers.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const V68_VERSION="6.8";
const V68_SETTLE_EPSILON=.002;

/* At a shared interval boundary, the completed travel interval and the new
   settled interval both include the same timestamp in older builds. Prefer the
   post-arrival state so the puck is immediately actionable at an exact pass or
   shot endpoint, including after manual scrubbing. */

puckStateAt=function(time,timeline=buildPuckTimeline()){
  const t=Number(time)||0,intervals=timeline?.intervals||[];
  const endedTravel=intervals.some(interval=>interval.kind==="travel"&&Math.abs(t-(Number(interval.end)||0))<=.00011);
  return puckStateAtV67ForV68(endedTravel?t+.00025:t,timeline)
};

function v68ActionEnd(){

}
function v68PlaybackStopTime(){
  const end=v68ActionEnd();

     action instead of inside its inclusive endpoint. The displayed tenth of a
     second remains unchanged, while Pass and Shoot are immediately available. */
  return round(clamp(end+V68_SETTLE_EPSILON,0,state.timeline.duration),3)
}
v64PlaybackEnd=v68PlaybackStopTime;

/* Keep these defaults centralized for every fresh/reset state. normalizeState
   still overlays saved display preferences, so upgrades do not overwrite a
   coach's existing choices. */
const makeDefaultStateV67ForV68=makeDefaultState;
makeDefaultState=function(){
  const output=makeDefaultStateV67ForV68();
  output.version=APP_VERSION;
  output.playbookName="BOTD Playbook v6.8";
  output.display={...(output.display||{}),names:false,numbers:true,positions:true,leadership:false,offside:true};
  return output
};

function v68EnsureVersionState(){
  if(!state)return;
  state.version=APP_VERSION;
  if(/^BOTD Playbook v6\.7$/i.test(String(state.playbookName||"")))state.playbookName="BOTD Playbook v6.8";
  for(const option of state.variations||[])option.version=APP_VERSION
}
function v68PrepareVersionText(){
  document.title=`BOTD Hockey Coaching Aid v${APP_VERSION}`;
  document.documentElement.dataset.appVersion=APP_VERSION;
  for(const entry of Object.values(I18N||{}))if(entry?.appSubtitle)entry.appSubtitle=entry.appSubtitle.replace(/6\.\d+/g,APP_VERSION);
  const subtitle=document.querySelector(".brand-copy span");
  if(subtitle)subtitle.textContent=I18N[state?.appearance?.language||"en"]?.appSubtitle||`Hockey Playbook Studio · Version ${APP_VERSION}`
}

const initV67ForV68=init;
init=function(){
  window.__BOTD_READY=false;v68PrepareVersionText();
  const liveToast=toast;toast=()=>{};
  try{initV67ForV68()}finally{toast=liveToast}
  v68EnsureVersionState();v68PrepareVersionText();renderAll();v68PrepareVersionText();
  window.__BOTD_RELEASE_READY=APP_VERSION;window.__BOTD_READY=true;
  liveToast("Version 6.8: playback now settles after the final action so the puck is immediately actionable, fresh boards show Numbers and Positions, and goalie numbers are centered.",5200)
};

Object.assign(window.BOTD_TEST,{
  version:APP_VERSION,
  playbackActionEnd:v68ActionEnd,
  playbackEnd:v68PlaybackStopTime,
  playbackStateV68:()=>{const actionEnd=v68ActionEnd(),stop=v68PlaybackStopTime(),puck=puckStateAt(ui.playhead);return{actionEnd,stop,playhead:ui.playhead,playing:ui.playing,puckMode:puck.mode,puckHolder:puck.holder||null,canDirect:v60PuckCanBeDirected()}},
  defaultDisplayV68:()=>deepClone(makeDefaultState().display),
  goalieNumberGeometry:()=>{const node=document.querySelector(".goalie-token-number");if(!node)return null;const box=node.getBBox();return{x:Number(node.getAttribute("x")||0),y:Number(node.getAttribute("y")||0),cx:box.x+box.width/2,cy:box.y+box.height/2,width:box.width,height:box.height,transform:node.getAttribute("transform")||""}}
});


init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
